rows.en: Captain Bright, Lieutenant Douglas... Thank you for your work transporting the D-Weapons.
rows.notes: Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank 大佐 to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: ...By the way, how about it? Would you care for a Chinese steamed bun?
N-no... I'll have to decline.
I see... They're quite tasty, though.
...Hey, Tapp. Who's that old guy?
H-how should I know?
He looks like a scientist to me.
You three! You're being rude to Dr. Plato!
rows.notes: Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: Plato...!? D-don't tell me...!?
rows.notes: Recognition left as a deliberate unfinished exclamation, answered by Diane.

rows.en: That's right. Dr. Plato is Linda's father.
rows.notes: Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: Diane!
...It's been a while, Kaine.
L-Linda! What are you doing here!?
Hee hee, I'm here too.
Rose, too! Aren't you all supposed to be at the refugee camp...?
rows.notes: Question trails off as in source.

rows.en: What the hell is going on!?
I'll explain now. First, this is Dr. Lang Plato...
rows.notes: Introduction continues in row 17.

rows.en: He defected from the Giganos Empire, developed the Metal Armors, and is Linda's father.
You're telling me this old guy is Linda's dad!?
Ha ha ha! Linda takes after her mother.
Yeah, I can tell that just by looking at her.
Watch your mouth, Wakaba. The doctor defected to the Federation out of personal conviction...
rows.notes: Douglas addresses Kaine by surname; source trails off.

rows.en: You could even say he's done more than anyone else for the war against Giganos.
No... I'm no hero. I'm the man who gave this war its cause.
Giganos's leader, Guiltorre, used the Metal Armors I developed
rows.notes: Guiltorre is the subject; the sentence cuts after the developed Metal Armors and continues in row 25.

rows.en: to launch his war against the Federation. That would be no exaggeration...
rows.notes: Completes row 24; no-exaggeration qualification remains in this source row.

rows.en: Father...
To atone for that sin, I must bring this war to an end as quickly as possible.
Then... were you the one who tried to hand the Dragonars over to the Federation military...?
rows.notes: Unfinished question about the transfer initiator; Plato answers in row 29.

rows.en: Yes, it was me. But a series of coincidences... ended up dragging you all into this war.
I truly am sorry about that.
Well, there's no point dwelling on it now... You don't have to worry about it.
Exactly. Besides, here in Chongqing, we'll finally be released from duty.
...Yes, you will. Thank you for all your hard work over such a long time.
By the way, Dr. Plato... I heard that you had died after the war began...
rows.notes: Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: That was false information Giganos spread to protect its image of unbreakable unity.
In fact, our intelligence division and one other person carried out an operation to help the doctor escape.
rows.notes: The unnamed helper stays gender-neutral.

rows.en: Huh!? Diane, you were in the intelligence division!?
Why, I told you at the farewell party, didn't I?
You mean before we boarded the Aquapolis? I-I thought you were joking...
rows.notes: Farewell-party callback before the Aquapolis voyage.
uncertain: Aquapolis follows the sourced campaign glossary transliteration; that entry does not claim an independently established canonical English spelling.

rows.en: My mission was to protect Linda, the doctor's daughter.
I-I had no idea...
To deceive your enemies, you have to deceive your friends first, Light.
But I can understand Linda being here. Why are you here too, Rose?
Before you say that, would you take a look at the gleaming rank insignia on my collar?
Gah! Th-that's...!?
rows.notes: Recognition fragment retained.

rows.en: That's a second lieutenant's insignia!?
rows.notes: Restored subject and verb to the insignia identification.

rows.en: That's right. I'm now Special Duty Second Lieutenant Rose Pattenton.
rows.notes: Special-duty rank translated literally; full name follows glossary.
uncertain: Special Duty Second Lieutenant is a literal rendering of the source rank; a specific established English rank equivalent was not supplied by the glossary.

rows.en: H-how come you're...!?
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished disbelief retained.

rows.en: ...Rose and I are helping Father with his research.
By the way, Linda is a first lieutenant.
F-first lieutenant...!? So she outranks us!?
Y-yes, I guess she does.
Oh, but you don't have to salute us.
Let's keep getting along like we did aboard the Idaho. Okay?
Don't give me that!
rows.notes: Tapp rejects Rose treating military service casually; anger preserved.
Source nonverbal surprise retained.

rows.en: Why the hell are you in the military!?
T-Tapp...
rows.notes: Address fragment retained.

rows.en: ...I decided to do this myself. Nobody forced me into it.
Look, you know what war is like too, don't you!?
You'd have faced less danger if you'd stayed at the refugee camp... So why are you at a base like this!?
...I want to end this war soon. Otherwise, more people will lose their families like I did...
rows.notes: Restored Rose as actor seeking to end the war; family loss preserved.
Source stunned nonverbal reaction retained.

rows.en: ...I'm sorry, everyone. Our situation is desperate, and we don't have much time.
...Understood, Doctor. So, what should we do with the Dragonars?
Take them to the factory immediately. There, we'll extract the combat data from Kaine and his friends
rows.notes: Plato asks Douglas to transport machines; data extraction sentence continues in row 67.

rows.en: and feed it back into the mass-produced Dragoons.
rows.notes: Completes the data-feed sentence from row 66.

rows.en: Dragoon... Is that the name of the mass-produced Dragonar?
That's right. It's a Metal Armor combining the strengths of Dragonar-1, Dragonar-2 and Dragonar-3...
rows.notes: Source trailing technical description retained.

rows.en: If we send large numbers of Dragoons to the front, with their low production cost and ability to fly on their own,
rows.notes: Conditional sentence continues across row 71.

rows.en: the Federation forces can gain the upper hand in the ground war.
rows.notes: Completes row 70 conditional result.

rows.en: I see. Most current mass-produced mobile suits can't fly on their own, after all.
Solving that problem alone would mean a great deal to the Federation forces...
Yes. Ultimately, numbers win wars... Things aren't so easy that a handful of high-performance machines can turn the tide.
However skilled you may be, you can't defeat every enemy.
...I believe I'm well aware of that.
But even for the Dragoons...
rows.notes: Source adversative lead-in retained; the sentence continues through rows 78-79.

rows.en: facing the Martian Successors, who are expected to make full use of Boson Jump technology, or
rows.notes: Enemy-list fragment retained at the source cutoff; the predicate comes in row 79.

rows.en: the Tekkoryu (Iron Dragon) with its special machines, Dolems, Angels and the like would be difficult.
rows.notes: Completes rows 77-78 with the difficulty predicate; Tekkoryu special machines remain distinct from Dolems and Angels.

rows.en: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth... And special combat forces against special combat forces...
rows.notes: Proverb and deliberate parallel fragment preserved; special combat forces refers to the exceptional enemy combat capabilities in originals77-79.

rows.en: You will have to work harder than ever before.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Yes, we understand that too.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.
Silence has two original uses, before battle and battle event4; both reviewed.

rows.en: ...In any case, Kaine and his friends' mission will end once the Dragonars' data has been transferred.
rows.notes: Kaine and his friends are the three Dragonar pilots; their mission ends after data transfer.

rows.en: As promised, I will also cancel your pilot registrations.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: ...Thank you.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Then let us start work at once. A Giganos special forces unit is targeting this base, so we must hurry.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Special forces...?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Yes... They've been attacking for some time now, targeting the Dragoon factory.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: They are most likely the Gon Jem Squad, despised as "Giganos's Filth"...
rows.notes: Gon Jem Squad and its insulting epithet follow the glossary; no softening.

rows.en: Once they learn the Nahel Argama has arrived here, they will launch a full-scale attack.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: W-with people like that after you, I'm amazed you've been safe all this time...
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Yes, a highly skilled pilot has been protecting us. I think he'll come to see us soon...
rows.notes: The unnamed defender is Quattro, revealed in original95; he follows sourced male profile.

rows.en: ...Excuse me.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Captain Quattro...!
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: It's been a long time, Captain. Since Operation Maelstrom, was it?
rows.notes: Operation Maelstrom follows the newly sourced central campaign term; official distributor synopsis confirms spelling.

rows.en: Y-yes... But what are you doing here, Captain?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: He's been helping me ever since I escaped from Giganos.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Even now, he serves as the commander of Chongqing Base's defense force.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Then the person who helped you escape was...?
rows.notes: Doctor refers to Dr. Plato, not Quattro.

rows.en: Yes, Captain Quattro.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: But, Captain... You...
rows.notes: Bright deliberately trails off addressing Quattro; unfinished line retained.

rows.en: ...It's true that even after the battle with Haman, the Federation's system hasn't improved, but...
rows.notes: Sentence continues into next row; trailing but preserved.

rows.en: That doesn't mean I can let the Giganos Empire become a second Neo Zeon.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: Besides, it seems the times still need the power of a man like me. ...Does that answer displease you, Captain?
rows.notes: Quattro addresses Bright as ship captain; retains self-assured justification.

rows.en: No. If you'll fight alongside us again, that's enough for me. I'll be counting on you, Captain.
rows.notes: Bright asks Quattro to help; I will be counting on you preserves request direction.

rows.en: ...Yes.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: ...They've just started extracting the Dragonars' combat data at the factory.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Your pilot registrations will be canceled as soon as that is finished.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Whew, I can finally get this weight off my shoulders.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: With your registrations canceled, you will be discharged from the military, but...
rows.notes: Sentence is cut before the surveillance condition in next row; but retained.

rows.en: Until this war ends, you will have to live in a facility under military surveillance.
rows.notes: Facility under military surveillance is compulsory until the war ends, not immediate freedom.

rows.en: What!? What's that supposed to mean!?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: We've been exposed to military secrets: the Dragonars. Normally, we'd face a firing squad. A firing squad!
rows.notes: Firing squad threat and its deliberate repetition retained.

rows.en: But that's not what you told us!
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: ...This is the biggest concession we can make. Please understand that, Kaine.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: But if we accept those terms, we won't have to fight anymore, right?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Yes. At the very least, you can leave the Nahel Argama.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: So even with the military watching us, our chances of survival will be much better...
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Once we're no use to you, you want us gone, huh? Something about that doesn't sit right with me...
rows.notes: Kaine resents being discarded after the military has extracted the data.

rows.en: ...Whatever brought you here, the military's top brass recognizes what you've accomplished.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: That's why you'll receive a reward when you're discharged, and you'll also qualify for a special pension.
rows.notes: Reward and eligibility for a special pension are separate benefits.

rows.en: How much does that all add up to?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Two million dollars each.
rows.notes: Two million is per person, not a group total.

rows.en: Two million! With that much, I could give my family an easy life and even start a business!
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: And... There is one more option available to you.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: An option? What is it?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: ...You can stay in the military and keep fighting with the Nahel Argama unit.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: In that case, you will be awarded the Salem Medal.
rows.notes: Salem Medal follows the central source-literal entry; cash reward and continued-service medal are distinct options.
uncertain: Exact independently licensed English medal label unestablished; central entry uses source-literal Salem Medal, with Salem award spelling/context corroborated by MAHQ.

rows.en: A medal, huh? They're treating us like heroes.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: What happens to the reward then?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Naturally, you would no longer receive it.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Y-you've gotta be kidding! No way am I doing that! Kaine, Light, you agree, right!?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: ...Y-yeah, I guess.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: H-hey... What's wrong with you? If we put up with it for a little while, we get two million! We don't have to fight anymore!
rows.notes: Tapp argues that enduring surveillance earns the payout and ends their fighting.

rows.en: ...Hey, Diane. When will our pilot registrations be canceled?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Apparently, extracting the data will take all day today... So it will be tomorrow.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Then give me until then to think it over.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: ...I'd like time to think too.
rows.notes: Light also asks for time to think; restored contextual subject and verb rather than bare Me too.

rows.en: W-wait, both of you! Hey, this isn't funny!!
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: ...What do you think, Lieutenant?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: I don't know. But we owe it partly to them that we've made it this far.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Those three have run us ragged all this time, but...
rows.notes: Sentence continues into row144; trailing but preserved.

rows.en: I think I'd miss them if they were gone.
rows.notes: Douglas admits he would miss the pilots despite their troublemaking.

rows.en: Oh? It sounds like you want them to stay, Lieutenant.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Don't joke about that. Who knows what will happen to me if I have any more to do with them?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: If I could, I'd like to cut all ties with them right here and now.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Hehe... I wonder about that.
rows.notes: Diane privately doubts Douglas wants to cut ties; actual thought fitting used.

rows.en: Oh, Kaine and the others are back.
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Well, everyone's here... What's going on?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Well, we were wondering what you'd decided...
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: Oh, that's already decided. Sorry, everyone, but this is where we say goodbye.
rows.notes: Tapp speaks for the trio, but their hesitation just established makes his confidence pointed.

rows.en: I thought so...
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: ...Tapp, won't you reconsider?
rows.notes: Context and listener checked against original neighbors; subject and action restored where needed.

rows.en: What's there to reconsider? I'm not doing all this fighting because I want to.
rows.notes: Combat described colloquially without introducing a specific killing claim.

rows.en: Neither did I. But...
rows.notes: Akira says he also never wanted to fight; deliberate But cutoff retained.

rows.en: Stop, Akira. If that's what they've decided, we have no right to stop them.
rows.notes: Daisuke asks Akira to stop pressuring the three; their decision remains theirs.

rows.en: Yeah. Cowards should get off the ship right away.
rows.notes: Tetsuya insults all three as cowards; no softened wording.

rows.en: What...!?
rows.notes: Kaine responds angrily to coward accusation; standalone reaction fragment retained.

rows.en: Oh dear. That was rather harsh.
Hey, Tetsuya... What the hell do you mean, we're cowards!?
I mean exactly what I said.
Tetsuya, that's going too far. Anyone would rather avoid fighting if they could.
But it's different for people who have the means to fight.
Anyone who chooses to abandon the fight to protect what they ought to protect and walks away is nothing but a coward.
rows.notes: Restored the subject of the generalized accusation; keeps voluntary abandonment and duty to protect.

rows.en: There are people out there who die without being able to protect what they should, you know.

rows.notes: Retained source nonverbal reaction.

rows.en: I didn't choose to join this war like you did.
I only came this far because I wanted to survive!
Then why didn't you run away before now? You must have had plenty of chances.
Th-that's...!
rows.notes: Retained deliberately unfinished stammer.

rows.en: That's enough, Tetsuya. If Kaine and the others made their own decision, what's wrong with that?
Yes. All we can do is send them off with a smile.
Then let me say one last thing. If you stop piloting the Dragonars here, you'll regret it for the rest of your lives.
Heh, I'll regret it if I don't quit.
rows.notes: Tapp reverses Tetsuya's warning: he says remaining, rather than quitting, would bring regret.

rows.en: Then do whatever you want.
Yeah, I will. You don't have to tell me.
Good grief. This is a perfect example of trading insult for insult.
rows.notes: Rendered the reciprocal provocation idiom as trading insult for insult.

rows.en: ...I haven't known you guys for long, but I thought you had more guts than this.
...Hmm. Kaine and the others' data is better than I expected.
They haven't survived this long by sheer luck, then.
Yes. They're drawing out the Dragonars' full potential, and then some.
...By the way, Linda. How is that work coming along?
We've finished replacing the frames and parts. Only the weapons remain.
Oh! That's progressing faster than I expected, too.
It's thanks to the line you set up in advance, Father.
I think we can have them ready for startup tests by tomorrow morning.
Hmm... I hope all that work doesn't go to waste.

rows.notes: Retained silence, valid in both prebattle and postbattle uses.

rows.en: ...So, Diane... What have Kaine and the others decided?
They've asked for time to think. Though Tapp seems set on quitting...
I knew it... He just doesn't understand a thing.
rows.notes: He refers to Tapp, immediately identified in Diane's preceding line.

rows.en: But I don't want to force Kaine and the others... Even if those three machines go to waste...
rows.notes: Those three machines refers to the three Dragonars being refitted; preserves trailing hesitation.

rows.en: ...Diane, would you go and fetch Kaine and the others for me?
rows.notes: Plato asks Diane to fetch the three pilots; request direction retained.

rows.en: Huh?
Father, are you going to...
rows.notes: Retained Linda's interrupted conjecture.

rows.en: No. I don't intend to tell them about that.
rows.notes: That refers to the ongoing Dragonar refit; Plato withholds that information.

rows.en: I'd like them to see how the mass-produced models perform with the Dragonars' data transferred into them.
In a mock battle, of course, rather than actual combat.
rows.notes: Restored the test context from preceding row: mock battle versus real combat.

rows.en: Understood, Doctor.
Colonel, I brought those people here.
Good work, Zin. So, are you the ones who asked to break in your prototype with my squad...?
rows.notes: Preserved Gon Jem's trailing inquiry.

rows.en: We are.
Hmph. What's your name?
I'm Albero Esto.
Hmm? I've heard that name somewhere...
rows.notes: Retained trailing recollection.

rows.en: Colonel, do you know this guy?
No, this is the first time we've met, but I've heard his name before. Now, where was it...? I can't remember.
Hahaha! Maybe you're getting old, Colonel?
So, what's the woman's name?
I'm Eldy Middi.
Well, well... She's a beauty, now I get a good look. Hey, Albero. Lend me that woman, and I'll help you out in all sorts of ways.
rows.notes: Preserved objectifying demand to lend him Eldy and offered cooperation; no softening.

rows.en: I refuse.
Tch, trying to look cool, huh? You'd better watch your back on moonless nights.
rows.notes: Moonless-night threat preserved.

rows.en: Hah! I can't stand watching jealous men.
I-I'm a little jealous...
Then why don't you pair up with Min?
You've got to be kidding! Who'd pair up with this lantern gorilla!?
rows.notes: Literal lantern gorilla insult kept for following lantern/gorilla misunderstanding.
uncertain: Literal lantern gorilla epithet preserves the lantern/gorilla callback; exact intended visual comparison is unclear.

rows.en: L-lantern? What'd you say?
rows.notes: Preserved lantern misunderstanding, settled by Zin's next reply.

rows.en: She called you a gorilla.
G-grrr...! I-I-I ain't no g-g-g-gorilla!! Raaaargh!!
rows.notes: Stammer and rage retained.
Retained source punctuation-only startled reaction.

rows.en: Easy there, Gol. You're scaring our guests, you know?
That's right. Especially the woman.
Our squad might be a little too much for a pampered little lady like you.
rows.notes: Pampered little lady conveys Min's taunt, not an asserted biography.

rows.en: ...Please don't concern yourself. My upbringing wasn't exactly refined, either.
rows.notes: Eldy denies refined upbringing while maintaining polite composure.

rows.en: You talk big. It'll be fun to see how long you keep up that brave front.
No need to worry about that, either. I intend to leave as soon as our business is finished.
Hehehe... Keep mouthing off, and you'll end up with worse than injuries, you know?
rows.notes: Threat explicitly exceeds mere injury, without inventing an outcome.
Silence fits events5/14/15.

rows.en: Hehehe, I'm drawn to strong-willed women like you.
Leave her alone. That old knight beside her is glaring at you.
rows.notes: Old knight refers to Albero beside Eldy.

rows.en: Fine by me. I'll take him on anytime.
...I'd heard they were a difficult bunch, but I never imagined it was this bad.
rows.notes: Actual thought kind; Albero reflects on the squad's behavior.

rows.en: Oh! Now I remember!!
W-what is it, Colonel? Don't scare me like that!
I remember now, Albero Esto... You were the commander of the Cry Wolves, weren't you?

rows.notes: Silence retained.

rows.en: Colonel, what's that whatchamacallit Wolves thing?
rows.notes: Gol garbles Cry Wolves; uses whatchamacallit Wolves rather than supplying the correct full term.

rows.en: They were an Earth Federation Army special task force. I hear they had a fair number of skilled people in their ranks.
But if their commander is here, that means...
rows.notes: Preserves cutoff; the next source row supplies betrayal or total destruction alternatives.

rows.en: Did he turn traitor or something? Or did his whole squad get wiped out?
rows.notes: Zin speculates about Albero and the destruction of the Cry Wolves; he is not asserting either happened.

rows.en: Well, I don't give a damn about the past. But if you're using a prototype shakedown as an excuse to steal the glory, that's another story.
We only need data on Medius from fighting the Nahel Argama squad. We have no intention of stealing your glory.
You say that, but you're not planning to use us as bait, are you?
Then I'll serve as the bait and lure out the Nahel Argama squad.
You can come out when you judge the time is right.
Of course, you're free to stay put... But in that case, we'll withdraw when we see fit, too.
rows.notes: Albero conditions his own withdrawal on Gon Jem refusing to emerge.

rows.en: ...I'll pay twice the going rate for fuel, ammunition and the like. How does that sound?
Guh heh heh. You're a man who knows how to do business. I like you.
Then let's see what the former commander of the Cry Wolves can do.
rows.notes: Cry Wolves source organization retained.

rows.en: Where should I lure them out?
I'll leave that to you. Contact us when the time is right.
Whether we come or not depends on our mood, though. Hee heh heh heh!
...Understood.
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down
rows.notes: Defeat-condition UI row, not spoken dialogue; grammatical condition matches source; no @ in source.

rows.en: Well, gentlemen... How does it feel to pilot a Dragoon?
It's a blast! Doesn't this thing have even more power than a Dragonar?
With these, we have nothing to fear from Giganos.
By the way, Doctor... What'll happen to the Dragonars after we leave the military?
Hm? Didn't I tell you? Once we've collected the data and finished testing, the Dragonars will be dismantled.
W-what!?
rows.notes: Identical astonished stutter serves all three uses; no scene-specific addition.

rows.en: Those three were prototypes built to collect all sorts of data in the first place.
Besides, they've picked up so many of your habits now that other pilots would find them hard to use.
You mean they're getting thrown out!?
We can't help it, can we? They won't have any pilots.
That's right. You could say they've lived out their natural lives.
rows.notes: Light likens retiring the Dragonars to reaching the end of their lives.

rows.en: Wait a minute! You guys are okay with that!?
How many times do you think the Dragonars have saved our lives!?
But there's nothing we can do about it anymore...
The data from our Dragonars will live on in the Dragoons. It's not like everything will be lost.
That doesn't mean I can give up on them so easily!
Hey, Kaine... Since when did you get so attached to the Dragonars?
Shut up! My way is to do right by anyone or anything that's helped me out!
rows.notes: Kaine includes machines in his principle of repaying help.

rows.en: ...So, gentlemen, are you ready for the test?
Hey, Doctor... Are you really going to take the Dragonars apart?
Couldn't you put them in a museum or something, like Mazinger?
The Dragonars are weapons. Keeping weapons that no one uses is nothing but a waste.
Then if we stay in the military, you won't dismantle the Dragonars, right?
H-hey, Kaine!
Don't be an idiot! We'd lose both our bonuses and our pensions! There's no way I'm staying!
Oh, fine! I'm not as cold-hearted as you guys!
The Dragonars did so much for us, and you don't care if they're torn apart as long as you get paid!?
rows.notes: Kaine accuses Tapp and Light of valuing payment above the Dragonars.

rows.en: Go ahead and pay your debts to a machine all you want!
That's enough, you lot! We're starting the Dragoon test!

rows.notes: Silence retained for both uses.

rows.en: Listen up! We'll now deploy AI-controlled Metal Armors. You must destroy them with your Dragoons.
You got it, Lieutenant.
The targets are coming out.
Now... Let's see their skills in action.
Will they be able to fight in Dragoons they've never piloted before?
The Dragoon is easy to handle. It wouldn't be fit for mass production otherwise.
Of course, that also means it has its limits.
Don't worry, Lieutenant. They may not look it, but they're good when it counts.
That's true, but...
Kaine, Tapp, Light. This is your last mission. Stay sharp out there!
Understood!
Tch... Today was just a little warm-up.
rows.notes: Retreat line used at both battle events.

rows.en: You got lucky, Dragonars! The next time we meet will be the day you die!
rows.notes: Threat retained for both retreat events.

rows.en: You little brat! I'll kill you for coming after me!!
Heh! I'll show you just how different a Dragonar is from a Dragoon!!
rows.notes: Dragonar/Dragoon contrast refers to Kaine piloting his customized Dragonar.

rows.en: You bastard! I'll make you feel my rage over those two million dollars!!
rows.notes: Tapp resents forfeiting his discharge payout; original124-137/654-657 settle the money callback. Initial pay wording corrected to make grievance explicit.

rows.en: What the hell are you babbling about!?
So this is D-3! If I crush it, it'll be just like gouging out the Dragonars' eyes!
rows.notes: D-3 reconnaissance role motivates the eye-gouging image; image retained.

rows.en: Oh...? You're quicker on the uptake than you look!
I can't stand you! Showing off that shiny gold armor!
So this man is Gon Jem, Giganos's Filth...!
rows.notes: Glossary epithet retained.

rows.en: Fuh heh heh! I'll strip off that gold armor and build myself a temple with it!!
rows.notes: Temple joke relies on Quattro's gold armor.

rows.en: I don't know who the hell you are, but I'll turn you into rust on my sword!!
rows.notes: Sword-rust threat retained as a violent idiom.

rows.en: A sword stroke driven by evil cannot prevail against the radiance of my Kenro!
rows.notes: Kenro is the sourced sword name; Rom replies to Gon Jem.

rows.en: Answer me, Commander! What do you mean by surpassing it!?
rows.notes: Devil Gundam is the referent, settled by original768-774; no identity added to spoken text. Initial him corrected to it.

rows.en: I have no need to tell you!
Damn! Even if you do this, your son...
rows.notes: Deliberate cutoff at your son remains incomplete and resumes with the name in312.

rows.en: Folia Esto will never come back!!
rows.notes: Continuation of311; Folia Esto centrally approved from Akurasu Folia plus established Esto surname; son relationship is explicit in MX source.
uncertain: Full English compound is source-compositional; independently licensed full Folia Esto wording is unverified.

rows.en: I know that perfectly well! You can join my son and my men in death!!
rows.notes: Death verb makes explicit that Albero sends Hugo to his dead son and squadmates.

rows.en: I'll begin collecting sample data.
You cannot read my strength without a heart that knows justice!
rows.notes: Rom addresses Eldy, who has just announced collection of sample data.

rows.en: Dragonars! I-I'm gonna beat you so the Colonel will praise me!
rows.notes: Gol's clumsy voice and stutter retained without inventing a dialect.

rows.en: Now then, Dragonar... Plenty of people in Giganos have a grudge against you.
So if I take you down, I'll make a tidy sum!
What bad luck... You only just got upgraded, too. My chainsaw says it wants to slice you into pieces!
rows.notes: Min addresses newly upgraded Dragonars; chainsaw personification retained.

rows.en: My Metal Armor is a custom model too.
I'll show you the difference in our skills, you lousy pilots!
The sheer savagery coming from this man... He's dangerous!
Come on, you turtle bastard! I'll chop you up the moment you come out of your shell!
Heh... I thought everyone in Giganos was like that Blue Hawk or that little rich boy...
rows.notes: Blue Hawk and little rich boy remain separate source references; row ends in a trailing contrast.

rows.en: I never knew they had a bunch of bandits like you!
I'm honored by your praise! As thanks, I'll give you a taste of my Azure Dragon Sword!
rows.notes: Threat gives the listener a taste of the sword, not ownership of it.

rows.en: Ghh... He fights like a wild beast on instinct alone... Like a tiger!
That's right! Don't lump my Gon Jem Squad in with those pampered boys raised on the Moon!
Bring it on! Just hearing your voice gets me fired up for a fight!!
Ghh... His swordplay isn't so much unpredictable as utterly chaotic. I can't read it at all...!
rows.notes: Restored Ryoma as the one unable to read the chaotic swordplay.

rows.en: So this is the famous Getter! I'll cut all three machines down at once!
I don't like it! That godlike air of yours!
What power! This Metal Armor has been heavily tuned!
Well, I'll be damned! An angel's come down to the battlefield!
An angel... Does he mean the RahXephon...?
rows.notes: Angel refers to RahXephon, not a named Evangelion enemy.

rows.en: Too bad! I don't believe in gods or Buddha! Even if you're an angel, I'll cut you down!
What's a fine young thing like you doing with a hunched back like that!?
Huh...! Does he mean the EVA...?
rows.notes: Hunched posture refers to EVA, not Shinji personally.

rows.en: Nuhahaha! Come on, come on! It's dangerous to let your guard down on the battlefield, boy!!
Come on, what's wrong! Are you boys all done already!?
There's no way I'm losing to a bandit like him!
Don't lose your cool, #女愛称! Whatever you think of his mouth, this guy's skill is the real thing!
rows.notes: Male lead warns female lead; runtime nickname preserved.

rows.en: You bastard! I thought you were #男愛称's commanding officer, but you're with Giganos!
rows.notes: Kaine addresses Albero as the male lead's former commander.

rows.en: We'll use any means necessary to achieve our goal...!
So you don't care if that means fighting #男愛称 either!?
rows.notes: Kaine objects to Albero fighting the male lead to achieve his goal.

rows.en: This man... Is he Char Aznable, Zeon's Red Comet...!?
What is this... I sense something like a sinister aura coming from this man and his machine...!
rows.notes: Thought kind retained. Quattro senses an ominous aura from both Albero and his machine.

rows.en: This man's data will prove valuable to Medius too!
I don't know what you're planning, but using people's very existence for your own ends is hardly pleasant...!
You're Sai Saici, the Club Ace...!
Huh? You know who I am?
Yes... I know you...
And to defeat that devil, I need Medius to get to know you too!
rows.notes: Medius is the intended recipient of the opponent's combat data.

rows.en: Black Joker, Argo Gulski! I'll make your power nourishment for Medius!
Nourishment...? What are you fighting us for!?
It's all to defeat that devil! And to do that, I'll have you show me the power of the Shuffle Alliance!
rows.notes: That devil remains unspecified; do not substitute a guessed identity.

rows.en: A Gundam Fighter... I'll make your power nourishment for Medius!
W-what is with this guy...! This isn't fighting spirit. He's a mass of pure obsession!
Damn it...! Can't we do anything at all for the Dragonars...!?
rows.notes: Kaine's isolated event 10 thought concerns helping the Dragonars; retain actual thought kind.

rows.en: Father, Kaine and the others have destroyed all the targets.
Good. Rose, what was their time?
Um... They took considerably longer than the computer's predicted time.
Impossible... Those Dragoons have their data in them. There should be no problem with their compatibility with the machines.
rows.notes: Restored pilots as possessors of the stored data and subjects of machine compatibility.

rows.en: Hmm... I imagine the Dragoons are responsible for this result.
Huh...?
At any rate, thanks to them, we've identified the problem. That concludes the test.
Kaine, Tapp, Light, good work. Return to the hangar.
Roger. That means both we and the Dragonars really have outlived our usefulness.
rows.notes: Both pilots and Dragonars are dismissed from use; bitterness retained.

rows.en: Hey, Kaine... Don't get any funny ideas. I'm absolutely not staying in the military.
W-what's that!?
That was... the alarm for approaching enemies!
J-just when we were finally done! Hey, let's get back to the hangar, now!!
Torres, report the situation!
Enemy Metal Armor forces confirmed 30 kilometers east of Chongqing Base!
Approximately 50 machines! They're heading straight for us!
Fifty machines...! Are they seriously trying to wipe this place out!?
Captain Bright, leave the defense here to me and go intercept the enemy force.
rows.notes: Quattro asks Bright to sortie while Quattro handles local defense.

rows.en: Understood. All hands, Level 1 battle stations! Nahel Argama, launch!
Roger!
rows.notes: Torres acknowledges.

rows.en: W-wait! I'm coming too!!
Kaine!!
The enemy's coming! We can't be the only ones to sit this out, can we!?
Kaine, you don't need to fight. Leave the rest to us.
rows.notes: Duke asks Kaine to leave the fight to the departing allies.

rows.en: That's right. You don't have to push yourselves.
All right, we're off!
...This is Quattro. We'll now defend Chongqing Base. Airman Third Class Wakaba, you and your men are to return at once.
rows.notes: Rank follows campaign Airman Third Class entry; Wakaba is Kaine; order applies to all three pilots.

rows.en: B-but!
...If you stay there, you're certain to get caught up in the fighting, you know?
rows.notes: Quattro warns Kaine about being drawn into battle by remaining outside.

rows.en: The captain's right, Kaine. We don't have to fight anymore. Let's hurry back.
H-hey! These readings!!
rows.notes: Deliberate interrupted reaction to readings remains unfinished.

rows.en: Is it the enemy!?
Th-there are so many of them!
The Gon Jem Squad's main force...! So those earlier enemies were a diversion after all!
Hehehehe! Look at the shiny new models welcoming us!
rows.notes: Shiny new models means Dragoons; no added unit name.

rows.en: So that's the mass-produced Dragonar... It looks pretty pathetic, despite all the rumors.
Yeah. They're a hundred years too early if they think they can beat us with those.
rows.notes: Hundred-years-too-early idiom retained literally because Gol misunderstands it in the next row.

rows.en: A hundred years? It won't take that long! I'll smash 'em in ten minutes!!
rows.notes: Gol mistakes Min's idiom for a time estimate; rough contraction conveys coarse voice.

rows.en: Idiot, that's not what I meant.
...Zin, what's happening with the Nahel Argama?
Looks like Albero's force is doing a good job of drawing them away.
rows.notes: Drawing the Nahel Argama away is confirmed by the diversion and following jamming plan.

rows.en: Hyehehehe... That old man sure backed up his big talk.
rows.notes: The old man is Albero, who is occupying the Nahel Argama per fresh399.

rows.en: All right, Zin... Use your machine to jam their communications. That'll cut them off and leave them isolated.
rows.notes: Zin is ordered to jam the defenders; their isolation benefits Gon Jem.

rows.en: Then we'll haul in a big catch! Gwahahahaha!!
OK! Leave it to me, Colonel!
Second Lieutenant Pattenton, contact the Nahel Argama immediately!
rows.notes: Pattenton is Rose; retain surname and rank from the order.

rows.en: I-I can't! It looks like they're jamming our communications...!
rows.notes: Restore Rose as the subject of inability to contact the ship.

rows.en: W-what!?
What do we do, Kaine!?
What choice do we have!? If we don't fight too, Linda, Rose and the others will all get killed!!
D-damn it! I knew it would come to this!
All right, you lot! Take your time and make them suffer!!
Hyehehehe! Leave it to me, Colonel!
Father! At this rate, Kaine and the others will...!!
rows.notes: Retain the source trailing warning about Kaine and his teammates.

rows.en: ...Linda, have those three machines prepared for launch at once.
rows.notes: Those three machines are the concealed new Dragonars; keep the source vague.

rows.en: What!?
Doctor, surely you don't mean... You're going to let Kaine and the others use those!?
Of course. That is what I was developing them for in the first place.
rows.notes: Plato developed the machines for Kaine and his teammates.

rows.en: B-but...! Sending them out without even testing them...!
rows.notes: Retain an incredulous unfinished objection; no main-clause conclusion is supplied.

rows.en: Those three do well when it counts, don't they? We have no choice but to bet on that.
What on earth are you talking about...!?
There is no time for a detailed explanation now.
Captain Quattro, can you hear me? I'm having those three machines prepared for launch now.
rows.notes: Plato asks Quattro to stall while the three machines are prepared.

rows.en: I need you to buy us time until they're ready, whatever it takes.
rows.notes: Request direction is Plato asking Quattro to buy time for the base staff.

rows.en: He's going to send those out...? But under the circumstances, we have no choice.
rows.notes: Thought; Quattro recognizes the proposed machines without naming them.

rows.en: ...Quattro here. Understood.
All right, here I come!!
He's coming!?
rows.notes: Zin announces his attack in fresh425; restore him as the approaching attacker.

rows.en: Airman Third Class Wakaba, you and the others fall back to the rear.
rows.notes: Preserve Airman Third Class and source surname Wakaba.

rows.en: No, we'll take the front! Captain, I need you and the others to cover us!
rows.notes: Kaine asks Quattro and the others for covering support.

rows.en: Well, even if these are mass-produced models, we're still better at handling Dragonars. Why don't you leave this to us?
rows.notes: Dragonars refers to the machine family; currently piloting mass-produced Dragoons.

rows.en: ...Dr. Plato and the others are preparing the new machines for launch right now.
You must fall back to the rear so you can defend those machines as well.
New machines!? You've got something besides the Dragoon!?
Before that, who's going to pilot them!? Nobody told us we had replacement pilots!
No, we have pilots. We already do.
rows.notes: The pilots already present are Kaine, Tapp and Light; Quattro withholds that explanation.
Retain punctuation-only bewilderment.

rows.en: In any case, defend the base! I'll deal with them!
1. Kaine, Tapp, Light or Quattro shot down
rows.notes: Plain loss-condition row, one segment and no manual line break.

rows.en: Oh... Those guys aren't half bad.
Looks like those pilots have been through their share of tough battles.
But from where I'm standing... they're still wide open!!
W-what is with this guy!?
No! Break away, Wakaba!
Gwahahaha! It's too late now!!
U-urgh...!!
K-Kaine!!
Light! We're in trouble!!
We can't cover him like that! Kaine, get out of there now!!
rows.notes: Restore we as covering teammates, him as Kaine in the immediate danger.

rows.en: D-damn it...! My thrusters are shot...!!
Gwahahaha! Just as I thought, you're all show!
Shut up! I only just started piloting this thing!
That's your bad luck, kid!
Daaamn it...! If only I had my Dragonar, if only I had my Dragonar...!!
rows.notes: Retain repeated conditional and deliberate incomplete ending.

rows.en: Go on, say your prayers! I'll cut you clean in two!!
Hold it!
rows.notes: Hidden ??? retained.

rows.en: W-w-w-who's there!?
W-where are you!? Show yourself!!
That guy is...!?
rows.notes: Retain recognition fragment; no identity supplied.

rows.en: Those intoxicated by their own strength are sure to fall before one whose strength is greater...
rows.notes: Sentence deliberately continues in fresh458; retain the open ending.

rows.en: And they will be left to regret their own lack of judgment.
rows.notes: Restore they from preceding row while continuing the same sentence.

rows.en: People call that inevitable destruction...!
rows.notes: Literal catchphrase rendering; independently licensed English equivalent not established.
uncertain: Literal catchphrase: independent licensed English wording for inevitable destruction is unestablished.

rows.en: Where are you!?
Th-that guy is...!?
rows.notes: Retain interrupted recognition fragment.

rows.en: Huh!?
C-Colonel! Right above your head!!
rows.notes: Restore position as directly above Gon Jem.

rows.en: Oh!? Who the hell are you!?
I have no name to give the likes of you!
Where there is darkness, there is light. Where there is evil, there is justice...
rows.notes: Explicit existential clauses restore the source ellipsis of copulas.

rows.en: An emissary from the heavens, Kenryuu has arrived...!
rows.notes: Kenryuu retains exact glossary spelling.

rows.en: Shut your mouth!
You've got some nerve picking a fight with us, the Gon Jem Squad!
rows.notes: Gon Jem Squad is the fixed organization label.

rows.en: This is no place for a flamboyant fool like you!
rows.notes: Flamboyant refers to Rom's theatrical presentation; no invented appearance detail.

rows.en: But I cannot let villains like you go unpunished...!
And I will never abandon those who fight for justice!
What!? You insolent bastard! I'll finish you off first!!
Th-that guy...! Did he come to save me!?
rows.notes: Male pronoun follows sourced Rom profile and clear scene referent.

rows.en: Who on earth is he...!?
rows.notes: Male pronoun follows sourced Rom profile.

rows.en: Well, I don't really know either... but somehow, he always shows up at just the right moment.
rows.notes: Kaine answers Quattro about Rom's well-timed interventions.

rows.en: Now, leave this to me and go. A new power of the dragon awaits you...!
rows.notes: The dragon power is the new Dragonars; retain metaphor and conceal their identity.

rows.en: The power of the dragon? What the hell is that!?
Could he be talking about those machines...?
rows.notes: Quattro infers the new machines; tentative recognition remains tentative.

rows.en: There's no time to hesitate! Choose for yourselves and take that new power into your own hands!!
rows.notes: Rom urges voluntary action, not an order removing the boys' choice.

rows.en: Huh!? Wh-what!?
Wakaba, Oceano, Newman! Get to Hangar 3 while you can!
rows.notes: Quattro addresses the three pilots by glossary surnames.

rows.en: C-Captain Quattro, what are you talking about!?
Is there something in this Hangar 3 or whatever!?
You'll see when you get there. If you want to survive, do as I say!
O-okay! Tapp, Light! Let's go!!
Y-yeah!
Ah, to hell with it! Whatever happens, happens!!
rows.notes: Tapp resigns himself to following the instruction.

rows.en: Heh! So that lousy little act was to let them get away? But it's all a waste of time!
They haven't run away... They will return here! Until then, I'll be your opponent!
Fine by me! Come and get some!!
1. Rom or Quattro is shot down
rows.notes: Defeat condition, one plain segment; no @ in source.

rows.en: Dr. Plato! Those are our Dragonars in here, right!? Get them ready to launch, quick!
rows.notes: Request is directed from Kaine to the doctor; body name uses approved Dr. Lang Plato. Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: Wait a moment. I'm raising the hangar now.
rows.notes: Hangar being raised for launch; not the hatch opening at542.

rows.en: Kaine, this is the last time! Once this battle's over...
rows.notes: Source deliberate cutoff remains after battle over.

rows.en: Shut up! I've already made up my mind! Anyway, even if I leave the military...
rows.notes: Source deliberate cutoff continues at497; military departure is hypothetical.

rows.en: We'll never be able to live in peace as long as the likes of Giganos, Tekkoryu (Iron Dragon) and Gulfer are around!
rows.notes: Continuation of496; all three hostile factions named.

rows.en: So I'm going to beat the hell out of them myself!
What good does that do!? You're just choosing to raise your chances of getting killed!
...You never know what tomorrow has in store for anyone.
Besides... Kids younger than us are giving it their all. Running away now just wouldn't sit right with me.
rows.notes: Light objects to fleeing while younger teammates fight; his personal judgment restored.

rows.en: Then what about the bonus!? It's two million dollars! Two million!
I don't need that!
Sorry, Tapp. You'll have to run that business on your own.
rows.notes: Calls back to Tapp's planned business with his discharge money.

rows.en: Damn it! You guys are idiots! Throwing away two million dollars like that!
...Because I've been given something more important than that money.
rows.notes: The more important thing is left unnamed, as source does.

rows.en: Hey, you... You're about to say something cool, aren't you!?
Huh? You can tell?
Good. The setup is complete.
W-what the!? D-1's changed shape!!
M-my D-2 has too...!!
rows.notes: D-2 changed shape like D-1; same change supplied from preceding row.

rows.en: As for D-3... Huh. It looks the same.
D-Doctor, what on earth is this...!?
...By coming here, the Dragonars have completed their role as prototypes.
rows.notes: Prototype role ends on arrival for data extraction and upgrades.

rows.en: From now on, they'll demonstrate even greater power as frontline machines for the Nahel Argama squad.
...That's what these upgrades are for.
Then this is...!
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing recognition retains cutoff.

rows.en: Yes. The Dragonars reborn... D-1 Custom and D-2 Custom.
To me, these are the true Dragonars... And they are your Dragonars.
rows.notes: Doctor identifies upgraded Dragonars as the true realization of his design and as belonging to these pilots.

rows.en: A-awesome! With this thing, Gon Jem won't stand a chance!!
Um, Doctor... What about my D-3?
It looks the same, but I've improved its software's processing power, armor and output.
Well, this machine gets by on what's inside, not its looks.
All right! The new Dragonar squad is launching!
Wait, you three. If you pilot the Custom units here, you'll be considered to have no intention of leaving the military. You understand?
rows.notes: Diane warns that choosing Custom machines constitutes choosing to remain in service.

rows.en: Are you okay with that?
I know that a hundred times over! Two hundred, even!
Otherwise, we wouldn't have come back here.
Uh... Er...
rows.notes: Hesitation retained.

rows.en: ...Tapp.
rows.notes: Light addresses Tapp; name-only source fragment retained.

rows.en: A-all right! I'll stick with you guys too!!
...You're going straight into real combat. You can handle it, can't you?
Heh heh... This isn't our first time doing that!
Heh, that's right. All right, get aboard at once.
What the hell are Kaine and the others doing in there...!?
You'll see soon enough. Soon...
Soon enough...!?
rows.notes: Douglas echoes Linda's timing in disbelief, a genuine source fragment.

rows.en: Yes, I believe in Kaine and the others... I believe they'll choose for themselves and carve a path into the future...!
A path into the future...!?
rows.notes: Ben echoes Linda's phrase in disbelief; source fragment retained.

rows.en: ...Listen, you three. The reborn Dragonars have greater output and maneuverability.
Be very careful not to let them get away from you.
Roger!
rows.notes: Acknowledgment interjection.

rows.en: Good, open the hatch! Here come the true dragon riders!
rows.notes: Literal dragon riders preserves source Dragonar/dragoon wordplay; common noun, not a different named unit.
uncertain: Dragon riders is source-literal wordplay; exact English texture is uncertain. The announcement is of upgraded Dragonars, not a new named unit or mass-produced Dragoon.

rows.en: Hm!? What!?
Let's go! Dragonar!!
Th-this thing! Its power's on a whole other level!!
rows.notes: Power increase is expressed emphatically.

rows.en: Heh heh! They don't call it Custom for nothing!
A-are those... Dragonars!?
We're still Dragonars, but now we're the reborn Dragonar strike team!!
Heh. They got them running...!
rows.notes: Quattro observes successful startup, not a launch command.

rows.en: N-new Dragonars...! When did they come up with those...!?
Dr. Plato was planning the upgrades while he was developing the Dragoon.
rows.notes: Body doctor name uses approved Dr. Lang Plato; speaker remains Rose. Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: So all he had left to do was wait for the materials to arrive.
...Those idiots. Once they pilot those machines, there's no turning back...!
L-Lieutenant...!?
But... That's just like them. 2nd Lt. Pattenton, work with Airman Third Class Newman to contact the Nahel Argama squad.
rows.notes: Pattenton is Rose; Newman is Light. Douglas orders coordination and a report to the Nahel Argama squad. Initial measured four lines; abbreviated Second Lieutenant to 2nd Lt. and tightened coordination wording while retaining both ranks, names, report destination and direction.

rows.en: If we let those three get any more carried away, nothing good will come of it.
Y-yes, sir!
Lieutenant Douglas...
rows.notes: Ben's name/title address stays unfinished as source.

rows.en: We struggled to bring the Dragonars here... I'll be damned if we let them get destroyed. We'll give them all the support we can!
rows.notes: Douglas resolves to defend the machines they labored to bring and directs maximum support. Initial measured four lines; tightened arduous-transport clause, retaining refusal of destruction and collective full-support action.

rows.en: Understood, sir!
Hehehe! A little change in shape doesn't make any difference!
Boys, slaughter those brats!
Keep talking! We won't let you do whatever you want anymore!
I'll be watching you show the new dragon's power!
rows.notes: Rom addresses the upgraded Dragonar pilots; request direction is toward them.

rows.en: Yeah! Let's go, Tapp! Light!
Got it!
Yeah!
Heaven, earth, fire, water... Grant me your power...!
rows.notes: Rom invokes four natural forces for power.

rows.en: Piiile Fooormation!!
rows.notes: Rom shouts Pile Formation, elongated.

rows.en: Baaaikanfuuu!!
rows.notes: Rom shouts Baikanfu, elongated.

rows.en: W-what is that...!?
I don't know what it is, but it's so cool!
Hmm... Perhaps I should have given the Dragoons a more theatrical entrance too...
rows.notes: Dr. Plato jokes about the theatrical robot entrance, not combat performance.

rows.en: Is that machine Albero's!?
Tch! If you come here, those guys will...!
rows.notes: Gon Jem realizes Albero has led allied forces here; deliberate interrupted warning retained.

rows.en: All units, launch!
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: Are you all right, Kaine!?
Yeah! Both me and my Dragonar are fighting fit!
Before that... Haven't their shapes changed!?
Well, we're getting to the middle of the story... It's the obligatory power-up.
rows.notes: Light makes a metatextual middle-of-the-story upgrade joke.

rows.en: But D-3 looks just the same as before...
rows.notes: Mari compares D-3's visible shape with the others.

rows.en: Don't say that. There's more to this machine than its looks.
Never mind that! I'm counting on you for cover! We're still breaking these machines in!
rows.notes: Tapp asks arriving allies for covering support while the pilots break in their machines.

rows.en: What's with you? I haven't seen you for a little while, and now you're all positive.
Heh... I knew they weren't the sort to just run away like that.
...It looks like we've successfully lured them out.
Yes. Now we can concentrate on our original mission.

rows.notes: Name-only cry preserved.

rows.en: I know...! I won't let him get away this time!
rows.notes: Male lead is pursuing Albero; direction of pursuit restored.

rows.en: So... Is that the target you spoke of?
Yes. I'd like to obtain it if possible.
Obtain it? What for?
rows.notes: Eldy wants the target power source; shared across natural-energy and Daimos route contexts.

rows.en: Isn't a complete TE Engine the power source this Medius needs?
rows.notes: Source-short Medius retained; complete TE Engine is the proposed required source.

rows.en: The reports so far indicate that machine apparently synchronizes with the energy of the natural world...
rows.notes: Thought; natural-world energy synchronization is the claimed function, not guaranteed certainty.

rows.en: If I can acquire that function, my AI1 will grow even further...
rows.notes: Eldy wants to acquire the function for AI1's growth.

rows.en: What's wrong? Answer me, Eldy Middi.
...Obtaining that machine's power source is an order from Dr. Mitar Zapat.
rows.notes: Full named doctor and directive preserved.

rows.en: And it is also one way to surpass that devil.
rows.notes: Surpass, not defeat, foreshadows Albero's correction.

rows.en: What...!?
Commander!!
So you've come, #男愛称. But can you really turn your blade against me?
I won't hesitate to fight an "enemy". That's what you taught me.
rows.notes: Quotation on enemy retained; taught rule settles subject and speaker's action.

rows.en: That's right... That's the way.
But I'll have you tell me why. Why did you return to the battlefield? I want the reason!
...Do you want to know, #男愛称?
Yes. You'd quit the military yourself to answer for losing all your men except me back then...!
rows.notes: All subordinates except the male lead were lost; Albero voluntarily resigned to take responsibility.

rows.en: And didn't you abandon the battlefield to mourn my comrades and your son!?
rows.notes: Male lead says Albero left battle to mourn the lead's comrades and Albero's son.

rows.en: A son...!? That man had a son!?
rows.notes: Thought reacts to Albero having a son; no added name.

rows.en: And yet... Why did you come back!?
Heh... It's a trivial reason.
What!?
It's the natural feeling of someone robbed of something precious... Yes, revenge. Revenge against that devil.
rows.notes: Revenge for precious things taken is not softened.
Pure shock punctuation retained.

rows.en: ...A natural feeling... Revenge...
You know, don't you? That it has returned...
rows.notes: Return refers to the devil; sentence continues across 610.

rows.en: That the devil that destroyed the Cry Wolves has appeared again.
rows.notes: Continuation of 609 preserves the repeated that-clause.

rows.en: That devil... Does he mean the Devil Gundam!?
rows.notes: Female lead questions whether devil means Devil Gundam; does not assert identification.

rows.en: Then you're doing this to defeat it...!?
No. To surpass it.
rows.notes: Surpass explicitly corrects defeat from 612.

rows.en: Wha...t!? What do you mean, Commander!?
...That's enough talk. I'll have you become nourishment for Medius.
Ghh!!
...Beginning collection of #機体名's data.
rows.notes: Exact unit placeholder retained.

rows.en: This time, we're going to push it to the limit.
I don't mind, if it means helping him and AI1 grow.
rows.notes: Source pronoun him retained; antecedent may be Albero or anthropomorphized Medius, so no invented noun.
uncertain: The source pronoun refers to him; context does not unambiguously distinguish Albero from anthropomorphized Medius.

rows.en: Of course. That's my intention. Don't let AI1 have a rejection response.
rows.notes: AI1's rejection response is a biological/system metaphor; no diagnosis invented.

rows.en: Yes.
...AI1... There's nothing to fear. The more intense pain you endure, the stronger you'll become...
rows.notes: Thought addressed to AI1, with its growth linked to enduring pain.

rows.en: So you mustn't reject it. Accept the pain and suffering.
rows.notes: Thought imperative directs AI1 to accept pain.

rows.en: Even if the machine is wrecked as a result... I'll make sure you escape.
rows.notes: Eldy promises AI1 escape even if its machine is wrecked.

rows.en: Then let's go!!
1. Allied mothership shot down@2. Rom shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat-condition text; original single @ retained.

rows.en: Heh, hehehe... Yes, that's the way.
Commander!?
Listen, #男愛称. I'll appear before you time and time again...!
Each time, carve wounds into both your body and mine...!
rows.notes: Albero tells male lead to wound both of them during repeated encounters.

rows.en: What!?
...Forced activation of Lasmunanium.
Your usual trick! But I won't let you get away this time!!
...Primary armor repairs complete. However, serious damage to the frame remains.
We cannot continue fighting... I recommend leaving our withdrawal from the combat zone to AI1.
That's fine. Do it!
Yes. Random pattern calculated. Releasing decoys. Simulating an explosion.
rows.notes: Decoys are deployed to fake an explosion, not a real detonation.
Source punctuation-only shock kept exactly.

rows.en: Enemy reinforcements!?
No! That's...!!
rows.notes: Deliberate interrupted identification retained.

rows.en: W-why is that machine coming out of the Medius!?
rows.notes: Restore dummy machine emerging from Medius; shared both routes.
Punctuation-only alarm preserved.

rows.en: Did it self-destruct!?
What's happening, #女愛称!?
Th-that was... That explosion was...!
rows.notes: Recognition interrupted; both trailing clauses preserved.

rows.en: What's wrong!?
M-Middi's...!?
rows.notes: Thought; preserve possessive fragment without naming the theory; Ms. Middi is Aqua's teacher. Final follows root instruction to drop the teacher-address honorific while preserving teacher relationship in656.

rows.en: Hey, #女愛称!
Ah...! S-sorry...!
What happened to the Medius Locus!?
I-it pulled out... The small dummy machine really exploded, but... the Medius only faked its explosion...
rows.notes: Real explosion of small dummy contrasted with simulated Medius explosion.

rows.en: A fake explosion...!?
rows.notes: Echo question fragment preserved.

rows.en: It's some kind of optical effect... so convincing even sensors mistake it for a real explosion...
rows.notes: Restore it as the optical effect and sensors as the fooled observers; source ends trailing.

rows.en: How do you know that?
Because it has a distinctive signature... Because I knew about that...
rows.notes: Aqua knew its characteristic signature; she does not explain her teacher yet.

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'. The line is reused in i00r0a:3/16/62/97 (the interlude), so it is a neutral silence.

rows.en: Could Middi be in the Medius too...?
rows.notes: Thought; asks whether her teacher is aboard Medius, not asserting that identity. Final follows root instruction to drop the teacher-address honorific while preserving teacher relationship in656.

rows.en: N-no, that's impossible. Because my teacher... her theory...
rows.notes: Thought; retain both unfinished explanations. Final follows root instruction to drop the teacher-address honorific while preserving teacher relationship in656.

rows.en: That's taken care of...
Wait. You're Rom Stol of the Cronos tribe, aren't you?
rows.notes: Rom Stol and Cronos tribe follow the glossary exactly.

rows.en: Why has the Cronos tribe come to Earth?
All is as Kenro guides me... We shall meet again!
rows.notes: Kenro is the named sword; do not confuse with Kenryuu.

rows.en: He's gone...
Well, we drove off the enemy, so all's well for now.
But, Kaine... this is where we say goodbye.
Yeah, about that...
rows.notes: Source trails into the next scene; keep about-that fragment.

rows.en: Are you sure you're all right with this?
rows.notes: Bright checks the pilots' decision to remain in military service.

rows.en: Yes. We'll stay in the military and keep piloting the Dragonars.
Ahhh... So much for our reward money...
Tapp, Light, you don't have to go along with me, you know.
rows.notes: Kaine offers teammates the option to leave despite his own decision to stay.

rows.en: What are you talking about, Kaine? Without us, you'd be dead in no time.
That's right. We're the reason you're still alive.
If we left you here all alone, we'd be too worried to get a decent night's sleep.
Tch... That goes both ways, you know.
That's how it is, Captain Bright. We're a team.
Well, now they won't scrap the Dragonars. All's well that ends well.
Yes, yes. You're just the young men I thought you were.
Looks like everything turned out just the way you wanted, old man.
No, no, you made the decision yourselves. Besides, Linda is happy you're staying, too.
Really!?
You've made a fine decision, all of you. It seems I had you wrong.
W-well, thanks...
I'm counting on you, Airman Third Class Wakaba. I expect great things from you.
rows.notes: Douglas asks Wakaba to meet expectations; preserve request direction.

rows.en: Huh? The lieutenant's being awfully friendly.
Maybe deep down, even the lieutenant has a soft spot for Kaine...
rows.notes: Friendly feelings are a teasing soft spot, without adding a romantic claim.

rows.en: Well then, Lieutenant Douglas... please leave their future in our hands.
I'm counting on you, Captain. I'll be staying here at Chongqing Base.
rows.notes: Douglas asks Quattro to look after the pilots, then explains his transfer.

rows.en: So that means...?
rows.notes: Incomplete inference preserved.

rows.en: As of today, Lieutenant Douglas has left the ship and been reassigned to Chongqing Base.
I don't know whether to feel happy or sad...
Now, all three of you, please sign these documents...
Kaine... Wakaba... There...
rows.notes: Spoken signing of own name preserved.

rows.en: I've confirmed your handwritten signatures. That completes all the formalities.
Then, Airman Third Class Kaine Wakaba, Airman Third Class Tapp Oceano, and Airman Third Class Light Newman...
rows.notes: Full names and repeated Airman Third Class ranks deliberately preserved in initial draft.
