rows.en: Effective immediately, I assign these three to the Nahel Argama unit... and appoint each of them a Warrant Officer.
rows.notes: Bright appoints all three warrant officers; no invented commissioning ceremony.
uncertain: Rank ladder is source-derived; exact independently licensed English mappings are unestablished, particularly Staff Sergeant.

rows.en: Warrant Officer!? So we've... we've been promoted!?
uncertain: Rank ladder is source-derived; exact independently licensed English mappings are unestablished, particularly Staff Sergeant.

rows.en: I made the appointments on behalf of our superiors, but these are official orders. I expect even greater things from you now.
rows.notes: Acting appointment is formal despite Bright serving as proxy.

rows.en: Yes, sir! Understood, sir!
Woohoo! We're officers now, so our pay's going way up!
uncertain: Rank ladder is source-derived; exact independently licensed English mappings are unestablished, particularly Staff Sergeant.

rows.en: That's right. We've jumped six ranks in one go.
uncertain: Rank ladder is source-derived; exact independently licensed English mappings are unestablished, particularly Staff Sergeant.

rows.en: Airman Third Class, Airman Second Class, Airman First Class...
rows.notes: Rank ladder continues in700; retain unfinished list.
uncertain: Rank ladder is source-derived; exact independently licensed English mappings are unestablished, particularly Staff Sergeant.

rows.en: Corporal, Sergeant, Staff Sergeant... and then us, Warrant Officers!
rows.notes: Ranks rise into warrant officer, completing699.
uncertain: Rank ladder is source-derived; exact independently licensed English mappings are unestablished, particularly Staff Sergeant.

rows.en: So that means...
rows.notes: Incomplete inference preserved.

rows.en: You bet! We're the sergeant's superior officers now!
Urgh...! ...That is correct, sir...
rows.notes: Ben grudgingly addresses newly promoted Kaine as sir.

rows.en: I can't hear you, Sergeant Ben Rooney!
That's right! You have to speak clearly when reporting to a superior officer!
My apologies, sir!
rows.notes: Ben's apology retains deferential address without inventing additional dialogue.

rows.en: Oh, that feels good! I could get used to this!
Grr... Urgh...! These brats...!
rows.notes: Thought; angry groans and incomplete curse preserved.

rows.en: It seems you've learned what rank means, gentlemen.
Now perhaps you'll watch how you speak to Linda, since she's a lieutenant.
rows.notes: Plato points out that Lieutenant Linda still outranks the boys.

rows.en: Hey! Hold on a second!
Come to think of it, Rose is a second lieutenant too...!
If you laugh at rank, rank will make you cry...
rows.notes: Proverb play on laughing/crying at rank retained.

rows.en: Well, now you're officially members of the military, but don't forget what makes you who you are.
What makes us who we are?
Yes. I've left a wild streak in the Dragonars that the well-behaved Dragoon lacks.
rows.notes: Wild Dragonars contrast with well-behaved Dragoon; preserve metaphor.

rows.en: Only you boys, who don't fit the mold either, can bring that out. I'm counting on you.
rows.notes: Plato asks unconforming pilots to exploit the machines' wildness.

rows.en: Leave it to us, old man. You customized these Dragonars for us, and we'll rack up victories in them!
rows.notes: Kaine promises results to Plato; request direction is a response, not an appeal.

rows.en: Well then, we'll be going now.
...Was this really the right thing to do?
rows.notes: Diane questions the decision to let the young pilots remain in service.

rows.en: I have no right to say anything... In the end, I dragged them into this war.

rows.notes: Silence serves both scene-specific uses without added interpretation.

rows.en: I've also seen many young people get caught up in war.
Despite their doubts and pain, they each found their own reason to fight.
I think Kaine and the others decided to fight because, somewhere inside, they have their own reasons too.
rows.notes: Their own reasons refers back to young soldiers finding motives for fighting.

rows.en: If I may say so, I agree with Captain Bright as well.
rows.notes: Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank 大佐 to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: Then let us do what we can, to end this war as soon as possible...
Yes...
Now, let's finish handing over the Dragonars. Lieutenant Douglas, I need your help.
Understood. Captain... Please take care of those three. And... May fortune favor you in battle.
rows.notes: Douglas asks Bright to care for the three pilots, then wishes him battle fortune; request direction preserved.

rows.en: You too, Lieutenant. Thank you for all your hard work.
Diane, please arrange for Rose and Linda to join the Nahel Argama.
rows.notes: Doctor asks Diane to arrange Rose and Linda boarding; he is not offering to do it himself.

rows.en: Yes.
Um... Second Lieutenant Diane, will you be joining the Nahel Argama too?
No, I'll remain stationed in Chongqing.
I see...
Take care too, Sergeant. I look forward to the day we meet again.
Yes, ma'am! So do I!
Perfect timing. Sergeant Ben, help carry Linda and Rose's luggage. With Diane, of course.
rows.notes: Linda and Rose are the two boarding; the doctor pairs Ben with Diane to carry their luggage.

rows.en: Yes, sir! I'm confident in my strength! I'd be delighted to help the Second Lieutenant!
rows.notes: Ben eagerly offers help to Diane; her source rank Second Lieutenant restored in final.

rows.en: Mm-hm... He's an easy man to read.
rows.notes: Actual thought; doctor observes Ben's obvious affection for Diane.

rows.en: Well, I'll take my leave now.
...Medius Locus is clearly more powerful than the last time we saw it.
I think Lasmunanium is behind that, but...
rows.notes: Control of Lasmunanium carries into745. Stray quote/break ignored.

rows.en: I can't imagine Albero Esto is controlling it.
Are you saying there's another person aboard that machine?
I don't know... At least, as far as I could tell from Medius's spec sheet, it only seats one person.
...Why did you know how Medius could escape?
Because someone taught me about it when I was at the military academy.
Then isn't that person aboard Medius Locus?
That's impossible. They wouldn't do something like that.
rows.notes: Teacher gender not exposed in speech; singular they refers to the unspecified person.
Silence; stray quote/break ignored.

rows.en: But my teacher and Dr. Zapat definitely have some kind of connection...
rows.notes: Actual thought. Teacher identity not named despite known glossary profile; Dr. Zapat source surname retained.

rows.en: But if my teacher was involved in developing Medius...
rows.notes: Thought deliberately trails off conditional development clause, continued by755.

rows.en: That machine should be an unmanned unit equipped with an artificial intelligence for combat.
rows.notes: Continuation of754; full AI/unmanned meaning retained.

rows.en: And... That's what my teacher was aiming to create.

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'.

rows.en: Hey, #男愛称. Could you tell me just one thing?
rows.notes: Aqua asks Hugo for one answer; exact runtime nickname placeholder retained.

rows.en: That revenge Albero Esto spoke of... Could it be...
rows.notes: Unfinished question about Albero's revenge, answered by759.

rows.en: It's just as you think. The Cry Wolves, my old unit, were wiped out in a battle with the Devil Gundam.
And Albero and I were the ones who survived...
rows.notes: Two survivors are Hugo and Albero; not an added claim that others survived.

rows.en: He was held responsible for the loss of the entire unit, and left the military of his own accord.
rows.notes: Albero voluntarily left after being held responsible for unit annihilation.

rows.en: To mourn my comrades... And his own son, Folia...
rows.notes: Source purpose-clause fragment continues761 and trails after Folia. His son is Albero's, not Hugo's.

rows.en: But he came back to the battlefield... To take revenge on the Devil Gundam...
...I don't think that's all there is to it.

rows.notes: Female lead to male; surprised reaction. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary. Retained source fragment/continuation: Huh...!? is surprise interjection.

rows.en: The Devil Gundam's return was only discovered after Medius Locus was stolen.
rows.notes: Known discovery date, not a claim about the true date of revival.

rows.en: In other words, Albero most likely only learned that devil was active again after he started piloting Medius.
rows.notes: High-probability inference is preserved rather than promoted to certainty.

rows.en: But it's possible he was planning revenge from the start...
rows.notes: Source trails off while floating an alternative possibility.

rows.en: Or Dr. Zapat, who knew about the Cry Wolves, might have recruited him.
If so, he'd have had no need or reason to leave the military voluntarily.
rows.notes: Hugo rejects the recruitment theory because Albero would not need to leave voluntarily.

rows.en: ...Just like me.
rows.notes: Comparative source fragment links to Hugo's own remaining in service.

rows.en: He must have some goal besides revenge on the Devil Gundam...
rows.notes: Actual thought in earth route; other route variant uses a distinct owner and is not output here.

rows.en: What is it? Commander... No, Albero Esto...
rows.notes: Actual thought; Commander self-corrects to Albero Esto.

rows.en: ...Some part of me always felt you'd stay in the military, Kaine...
Why's that?
Because it seemed like you were starting to find something through fighting... I can't really explain it, but something...
Maybe... Anyway, Linda, why are you helping the military?
You hated fighting so much when you were with us...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing reminder retained.

rows.en: ...My hatred of war was the same as my hatred of my father...
rows.notes: Linda connects hatred of war with hatred of her father; neither hatred is softened.

rows.en: Your father... You mean that old guy...?
Yes... The war started with the Metal Armors my father developed.
And when my father defected to the Federation, the war spread...
But, you know, that was...
rows.notes: Kaine's interrupted reply retained.

rows.en: ...Now I understand he only reached that decision after a great deal of hardship.
So, to make sure my own ideals don't remain mere ideals,
rows.notes: Purpose clause intentionally remains unfinished and resumes with decision/action in785.

rows.en: I decided to put myself in a war, even though it contradicts those ideals. I thought I was bound to discover something that way.
rows.notes: Linda intentionally joins warfare despite ideals; hopeful discovery is not specific new knowledge.

rows.en: That's right, Linda! Just thinking about things in your head won't change anything!
But... I still haven't forgiven my father for everything...
rows.notes: Not total forgiveness; Linda still resents father's actions.

rows.en: He tore our family apart too, after all...
rows.notes: Family separation remains father's responsibility in Linda's view.

rows.en: ...Linda, I... I met the Blue Hawk of Giganos in Kyoto.
rows.notes: Sourced title Blue Hawk of Giganos, no added identity.
Punctuation-only shock retained.

rows.en: Hey, Linda... About that guy...
rows.notes: Deliberate incomplete topic mention, no invented identity question.

rows.en: I'm sorry, Kaine. Please don't ask me anything right now...
...But someday I'll tell you everything... So please wait until then...
rows.notes: Linda asks Kaine to wait; not a promise that he should ask immediately.

rows.en: Yeah, I understand...
Rose and I will be joining you and the others as operators, Kaine.
rows.notes: Linda and Rose are operators accompanying the team, not pilots.

rows.en: Then we'll be together all the time from now on!
Yes...
Linda...
rows.notes: Name-only intimate address retained.

rows.en: Oh! So this is where you've been, Kaine!
Gah... Light and Tapp! And everyone else, too!
Oh... Were we interrupting something?
You bastard! If you think so, then get lost!
Don't be so cold. We wanted to give you guys a proper welcome now that you've stayed aboard.
rows.notes: Koji welcomes the three Dragonar pilots back after their decision to remain.

rows.en: You're making a big deal out of it. Nothing's changed from before.
Don't worry about it. This sort of thing is for good luck.
Misato's in a good mood because she won the bet after all.
But I'm happy too... that you and the others stayed, Kaine...
rows.notes: Shinji explicitly says he is happy Kaine's group stayed.

rows.en: Hmm... I never thought I'd hear you say something like that.
Well... We've come all this way together, and...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing clause about their shared time retained.

rows.en: Well... Even with guys like them, it'd be too quiet if they left. They're better than nothing.
Better than nothing? That's a bit...
rows.notes: Malformed source closing wrapper ignored; protest remains unfinished.

rows.en: Well, at least we won't have to worry about getting bored again.
Hey, Shinji! That's how it is, so I'm counting on you again.
rows.notes: Kaine asks Shinji for continued support, rather than offering Kaine's own help.

rows.en: Yes, Kaine.
If you ask me, I can't say no. So I guess I'm heading back to the hell of the battlefield.
rows.notes: Kaine jokingly credits Shinji's request for his return to fighting.

rows.en: I'm sorry...
I'm kidding, I'm kidding! Well... At least my fighting meant enough to leave an impression on you.
rows.notes: Kaine is joking; his fighting mattered enough to leave an impression on Shinji.

rows.en: That's enough for now, Kaine. I'm glad you guys came back.
We'll be counting on you from now on, too.
Hehe... This sort of thing isn't half bad.
Kaine... This is where you belong, isn't it?
rows.notes: Linda tells Kaine he belongs with this group.

rows.en: And I hear Nergal's battleship will be coming from the Moon soon.
rows.notes: Nergal kept source-short; full Heavy Industries not added. Root approved the source-short alias derived from the established full entry.

rows.en: That Nadesico we've heard about? Sounds like things were rough in space too.
I hear they've picked up some new comrades too.
Perfect! Let's throw a welcome party and celebrate our return at the same time.
Ginga! You little punk, you had us worried sick!
Hehehe... Give me a break, Koji. Leo and Unicorn both came back safe and sound, too.
rows.notes: Leo and Unicorn remain source-short Data Weapon names. Root approved the source-short alias derived from the established full entry.

rows.en: Besides, I wish you all could've seen our great escape from Spiral Castle.
rows.notes: The escape was from Spiral Castle.

rows.en: Honestly... Watching it had me on pins and needles!
Hehe, you two have made up properly, haven't you?
rows.notes: The two who reconciled are Ginga and Hokuto.

rows.en: But I'm sorry, everyone... We made you all worry about us...
What are you saying, Hokuto? Of course we worry about our comrades. I'm glad you came back safely.
Thank you, Daisuke...
Kazuya Ryuzaki... So you're safe.
We were worried too when we heard we'd lost contact with the Mars region.
rows.notes: We restored for the allies worrying about Mars contact.

rows.en: I'm sorry...
What happened on Mars? Is Erika all right?

rows.notes: Silence has four actual uses across the two routes; no inferred response added.

rows.en: Huh... So that's Kazuya Ryuzaki, the one who fought Domon for the Colony Martial Arts Championship title...
rows.notes: Championship title matches current centralized Colony Martial Arts Championship term.

rows.en: A karate master, pilot of Battle Commander Daimos, and a key figure in ending the Baam War...
rows.notes: Nominal list intentionally continues into 841; Battle Commander Daimos follows protected name.

rows.en: And his girlfriend is Ambassador Erika from Baam. He's more than just a minor celebrity.
rows.notes: The girlfriend is Baam's Ambassador Erika.

rows.en: But weren't those two on Mars now?
Yeah. Why did he come to Earth... and to our unit, of all places?
I'll explain that.
Who are you?
I'm Kyoshiro Yuzuki. Kazuya and I go way back.
I'm Nana Izumi. I pilot the Gulver together with Kyoshiro.
rows.notes: Source-short Gulver follows protected full Gulver FXII name without expansion. Root approved the source-short alias derived from the established full entry.

rows.en: Kazuya and the two of us are counting on you.
rows.notes: Kyoshiro asks new allies to support Nana, himself and Kazuya; Nana is included from her preceding introduction.

rows.en: Huh... So is that Japanese sword on your back some kind of fashion statement?
No. Monsieur Yuzuki is a martial arts master who is every bit Monsieur Ryuzaki's equal.
rows.notes: French honorific Monsieur retained as spoken characterization; ASCII only.

rows.en: That's right. He's so good, it's almost a waste to keep him in a fighter plane.
Chibodee Crocket and George DeSand...
rows.notes: Ryoma names the two arriving fighters; intentional nominal reaction.

rows.en: In other words, Queen the Spade and Jack in Diamond. That brings the whole Shuffle Alliance together.
rows.notes: Their Shuffle titles are Queen the Spade and Jack in Diamond.

rows.en: Yes. Something has happened that requires us to unite once more.
The Devil Gundam?
Sure, that's part of it... But a lot's been happening in space too.
It seems some people more qualified than us to explain that have arrived.
rows.notes: George refers to the officers arriving for briefing.

rows.en: Everyone's here, I see.
Then we'll begin the briefing on our upcoming operations.
Before that... Let me introduce the Nadesico's captain.
Hello. I'm Ruri Hoshino, captain of the Nadesico B.
rows.notes: Full name Ruri Hoshino from glossary, no extra title added.

rows.en: So she's the famous...
rows.notes: Three pilots split one reacting description across 862-864; fragments preserved.

rows.en: The youngest ever...
rows.notes: Continues 862; youngest-ever descriptor preserved.

rows.en: Genius captain, huh...
rows.notes: Completes the split description; no added pretty-girl descriptor before the joke.

rows.en: You almost got the last part. You left out "pretty girl".
rows.notes: Saburota adds the pretty-girl descriptor omitted by Light.

rows.en: Captain Takasugi! You're supposed to introduce yourself first!
rows.notes: Source Captain Takasugi follows in-game rank in glossary.

rows.en: You just did it for me, didn't you?
It's not a self-introduction unless you do it yourself!
By the way, this boy is Ensign Hari Makibi, assistant first officer of the Nadesico B... He goes by Harry.
rows.notes: Full Hari Makibi remains distinct from the nickname Harry; Ensign/assistant first officer follow sourced naval roles.

rows.en: I see. Captain Takasugi and Harry, then.
rows.notes: Body nickname Harry, speaker Hari unchanged.

rows.en: ...I've already explained the enemy organizations' movements on Earth to Lieutenant Commander Hoshino.
rows.notes: Ruri's source rank rendered Lieutenant Commander from the glossary naval role.

rows.en: But the situation in space and the Mars region is developing in ways we never anticipated.
What exactly happened in the Mars region?
Mars has been conquered by force...
Are you saying some new aliens showed up!?
That might have been better, actually...
The people who attacked Mars call themselves the "Martian Successors"...
They're Jovian Federation remnants led by Lt. Gen. Haruki Kusakabe, its former de facto chief who vanished in the Lizard War.
rows.notes: Former de facto leader is Haruki Kusakabe; disappearance occurred during the Lizard War.

rows.en: Remnants of the Jovian Federation... Then the enemies we fought in Kyoto were...
rows.notes: Wooden abbreviation rendered with established faction English; deliberate cross-packet trailing inference.

rows.en: Yes, that's right. That too is a mobile weapon used by them... the Martian Successors.
rows.notes: Mobile weapon refers to Kyoto encounter; Martian Successors confirmed.

rows.en: But near the end of the Lizard War, as support for peace grew, that man Kusakabe insisted on fighting to the bitter end...
rows.notes: Ben continues877 context about Kusakabe; opening contrast and trailing continuation retained.

rows.en: I heard he was finally ousted in a coup, and no one has known his whereabouts since.
rows.notes: Restore he as Kusakabe; no current location revealed yet.

rows.en: The young moderates seized power... The so-called "Hot-Blooded Coup."
"Hot blood is not blind faith"...
rows.notes: Literal coup slogan repeated in959; keep identical independent English wording.
uncertain: Coup slogan rendered literally; exact independently licensed English wording unestablished.

rows.en: What's that?
It's the coup's rallying declaration, a sharp rebuttal to hardliners blinded by their "cause" and unable to see the situation.
rows.notes: Cause is the hardliners' ideal, not a person's name. Explicit rebuttal of refusal to read the situation.

rows.en: Those words will be remembered for generations.
Well, that coup turned Lieutenant General Kusakabe into a former lieutenant general...
rows.notes: Former rank is a joke contrasting pre-coup title with loss of position.

rows.en: But not only was he alive, he'd been steadily building up his forces for the past three years.
Our investigation shows he has a large number of supporters...
What's more, many of the people involved in the Hisago Plan were his agents.
Do the Martian Successors intend to seize control of the Hisago Plan?
That's not all. Their ultimate goal is to control every form of teleportation.
That's why they took over Little Baam too...
rows.notes: Little Baam is artificial body seized along with Mars; terminology sent to root.
uncertain: Little Baam is approved source-literal compound; independently licensed English name unestablished.

rows.en: I see... That artificial celestial body was also equipped with a warp navigation system.
Mind you, the system was badly damaged in the Baam War and still hadn't been restored to working order.
Erika was afraid it would be misused, so she left it that way. That was a blessing in disguise.
rows.notes: Erika's choice prevented easy reuse of the warp system; preserve blessing-in-disguise evaluation.

rows.en: But they've seized Little Baam and Mars, and they're holding Erika hostage to force her to repair the system...
rows.notes: Captors press Erika to repair the apparatus, not Erika demanding their repair.
uncertain: Little Baam is approved source-literal compound; independently licensed English name unestablished.

rows.en: They stole the Martian ruins that were being held in the terminal colony Amaterasu, then seized control of the Mars sphere...
rows.notes: Stolen ruins previously kept at Amaterasu; then Mars conquered.

rows.en: They're now holed up in Iwato, the ruins at Mars' polar cap.
rows.notes: Iwato is the named polar-cap ruins; term sent to root.
uncertain: Iwato is approved source romanization; independently licensed English name unestablished.

rows.en: In other words, the Boson Jump calculation unit is back in its old home.
rows.notes: Back where it belongs is idiom about return to Mars, not approval of theft.
uncertain: Calculation unit is approved literal apparatus term; independently licensed English equivalent unestablished.

rows.en: Then the A-Class Jumpers who make Boson Jump possible, who've been disappearing one after another for the past few years...
rows.notes: Retain unfinished inference about disappearances; no perpetrators asserted in this row.

rows.en: Well... it was probably to monopolize Boson Jump technology.

rows.notes: Silence retained in all nine original contexts.

rows.en: Captain... You're thinking about your old friends, Akito and Yurika, aren't you...
rows.notes: Thought Hari interprets silent Ruri; body names remain Akito and Yurika.

rows.en: The fact is, the Federation doesn't have a single A-Class Jumper left.
And on top of that, the calculation unit is in their hands too.
uncertain: Calculation unit is approved literal apparatus term; independently licensed English equivalent unestablished.

rows.en: So for now, teleportation is completely in their hands?
What do you expect the Martian Successors to do next?
rows.notes: Restore question about predicted Martian Successors action.

rows.en: ...They will probably use Boson Jump to seize all the Earth Federation's major facilities at once.
rows.notes: Ruri predicts coordinated seizure, does not report completed seizure.

rows.en: How can you sit there looking so calm!? We've got to get out there and defend those major facilities right now!
Calm down, Sai Saici. We still have time.
rows.notes: Domon addresses Sai Saici; time remains because teleportation control is incomplete.

rows.en: What do you mean?
Yes, they haven't fully mastered Boson Jump yet.
I see... If they could control it, things would be a mess all over the place by now.
Then now's our chance! Let's charge into Mars and finish them all off in one go!
Unfortunately, we can't do that. The Martian Successors have joined forces with Giganos in the Earth sphere.
What...!? Those Giganos bastards will team up with anyone...!
Come to think of it, they were fighting together in Kyoto too...
I fought Meio Plato, the Blue Hawk of Giganos, out in space too...
rows.notes: Full Meio Plato and epithet retain source forms.

rows.en: Giganos seems willing to use any means to bring down the Federation.
I see... I hadn't seen the Blue Hawk lately because he was out in space...
So if the Federation sends a long-term expedition to Mars, Giganos plans to go on the offensive while it's away...
rows.notes: Giganos offensive is inferred plan if Federation expeditions away; keep conditional.

rows.en: But if the conflict in the Earth sphere drags on, we'll give the Martian Successors time to perfect their control of teleportation.
Then what are we supposed to do!? What are the Federation bigwigs planning!?
They've decided to wait and see for the time being...
That's absurd...! They're going to let those bastards run wild!?
Well... even if we leave them alone, they won't have an easy time of it.
I see... The presence of Gulfer and the Vegan Empire is the key.
rows.notes: Organizations Gulfer and Vegan Empire follow fixed glossary.

rows.en: Exactly. As long as they operate in the Earth sphere, clashes with those aliens are inevitable...
In other words, they'll have to pursue strategies against those alien organizations at the same time as they fight the Federation.
rows.notes: They refers to Martian Successors/Giganos alliance discussed immediately before.

rows.en: And on Earth, there's the Hyakki Empire, Hau Dragon... and MU too.
How ironic. This time, the chaos of war is actually on our side...
Our superiors are taking action too. Our mission is to buy time until those measures are ready.
W-we're the decoys again...?
With the Nadesico joining us, we'll stand out even more...
Our unit will leave Chongqing Base tomorrow at 0100 hours... and return to Japan.
rows.notes: Ignore stray closing Japanese delimiter and @ indentation artifact; preserve departure time and destination.

rows.en: Everyone is to finish their preparations by 2300 hours today.
rows.notes: 2300 is same-day deadline before0100 departure next day.

rows.en: That is all. Dismissed.
rows.notes: Ignore stray closing delimiter and @ artifact; translate dismissal only.

rows.en: ...Got a minute?
You're from the Nadesico, aren't you...?
I'm Ryoko Subaru, an Aestivalis pilot. I'm counting on you.
rows.notes: Introduction asks listener for cooperation; direction kept as I am counting on you.

rows.en: Likewise. A beautiful new teammate is always welcome.
...Anyway, you've got data on that black machine, right? Let me borrow it.
rows.notes: Ryoko asks Light to lend data on black machine; no concealed pilot name added.

rows.en: The black machine...? Oh, the one we met in Kyoto that uses Boson Jump.
Are you interested in it for some reason?
...Don't ask questions you don't need to. Just show me the data.
Light, I'm asking you for it too.
rows.notes: Ruri reinforces Ryoko's request to Light.

rows.en: Well, if Captain Hoshino asks... no, if she orders me to...
rows.notes: Light corrects request to order and trails off; captain surname retained.

rows.en: Sorry, Ruri... I even made you step in.
...I was curious about it too.
Yeah... Akito and Yurika are like family to us...
rows.notes: Family to us includes both Ryoko and Ruri; no literal kinship invented.

rows.en: Especially to you, since you lived with them after the Lizard War...
rows.notes: Ruri specifically lived with Akito/Yurika after the war.

rows.en: That bastard Akito is the one piloting the black machine...
rows.notes: Thought Ryoko identifies Akito only when source does so.

rows.en: If the Martian Successors attacked Akito and Yurika to get their hands on A-Class Jumpers...
rows.notes: Conditional suspicion remains unfinished, not an assertion.

rows.en: Akito... What happened to you and Yurika over these past two years...
rows.notes: Thought addresses absent Akito; timeframe is two years, distinct from Kusakabe's three-year buildup.

rows.en: Haruki Kusakabe, former lieutenant general of the Jovian Federation. During the Lizard War, he was effectively its number one.
rows.notes: Jun's report begins Super route prebattle; full Haruki Kusakabe remains full.

rows.en: The young moderates who learned the truth of Major Tsukumo Shiratori's assassination... led by Rear Admiral Akiyama here...
rows.notes: Report fragment names moderate leaders incl present Rear Admiral Akiyama; sentence carries into958.

rows.en: They carried out a coup within the Jovian Federation against Lieutenant General Kusakabe, who called for all-out war with Earth...
rows.notes: Continues preceding report about coup; Earth is the war target.

rows.en: "Hot blood is not blind faith"... Ah, that takes me back.
rows.notes: Akiyama recalls same slogan884.
uncertain: Coup slogan rendered literally; exact independently licensed English wording unestablished.

rows.en: Hmm. That was a fine call to arms.
rows.notes: Responds to Akiyama recalling the coup's proclamation in original1123.

rows.en: ...In that "Hot-Blooded Coup," Kusakabe personally sortied and was supposed to have gone missing, but...
rows.notes: Hot-Blooded Coup is sourced glossary term; supposed disappearance contrasts with962.

rows.en: And yet he's alive and kicking inside that window! Why, even a frog would marvel at that sheer grit.
rows.notes: Window/frog/grit joke preserved from source. No additional theme-song lyrics or lore imported.
uncertain: Window/frog allusion texture is uncertain; literal joke preserved without imported lyrics.

rows.en: Hmmm... As a former member of the Jovian Federation, I'm truly sorry about all this.
rows.notes: Akiyama apologizes as a former Jovian, not for Jun's actions.

rows.en: Now, now...
According to the data Lieutenant Commander Hoshino brought back, Kusakabe has many supporters.
rows.notes: Root reviewed Ruri identity and approved rank Lieutenant Commander; Major corrected after corpus scan.

rows.en: Whether military officers or politicians, apparently every one of them was involved in drawing up the Hisago Plan.
In short, the Earth Federation set the stage for Kusakabe with the Hisago Plan.
Unfortunately, yes. Now, according to Lieutenant Commander Hoshino's report...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing introduction of Hoshino report retained. Root reviewed Ruri identity and approved rank Lieutenant Commander; Major corrected after corpus scan.

rows.en: The Crimson Group, which first proposed the plan...
rows.notes: Deliberate cutoff connects Crimson Group into anti-Nergal companies in970.

rows.en: and other anti-Nergal companies apparently had contact with Kusakabe as far back as the Lizard War.
rows.notes: Continuation of969; original contact goes back to Lizard War.

rows.en: We had Nadesico B carry out trials of the Hisago Plan because we feared something like this, but...
rows.notes: Testing was done because this risk was feared; trailing but retained.

rows.en: When all the people involved are in on the crime...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished explanation: insiders collectively involved in crime.

rows.en: If Brigadier General Azuma and the others had been a little more cooperative, we might have prevented this.
rows.notes: Counterfactual cooperation, prevention only possible not certain.

rows.en: There's no use saying that now. ...Aoi, what are the Martian Successors doing?
rows.notes: Aoi source surname is Jun, not a new speaker.

rows.en: After their uprising, they seized terminal colonies such as Kushinada and Sakuya one after another...
rows.notes: Named terminal colonies use centrally approved Kushinada/Sakuya romanizations.
uncertain: Kushinada and Sakuya are source romanizations; independently licensed English spellings unverified.

rows.en: They also took control of the Mars area. Their main force, together with the ruins they took from Amaterasu...
rows.notes: Main force plus Amaterasu ruins clause deliberately unfinished and continued by977. Self-review/root-approved meaning correction: restored Mars-area scope for source 火星圏.

rows.en: is holed up at Iwato, the polar-cap ruins that serve as the central point of the Hisago Plan.
rows.notes: Centrally approved Iwato and literal polar-cap ruins; no new place or mechanics.
uncertain: Iwato and polar-cap ruins are source-literal; independently licensed full designation unverified.

rows.en: So the Boson Jump calculation unit is back where it belongs, then?
rows.notes: Calculation unit returns to original site; idiom rendered naturally, no romance added.
uncertain: Calculation unit is a source-literal technical label; independently licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: Hmm... This is bad.
What about Little Baam, which had moved into the Mars area?
rows.notes: Centrally approved Little Baam. Source explicitly sets movement into Mars area.
uncertain: Little Baam is centrally approved source-literal name; independently licensed English rendering unverified.

rows.en: We believe it's already fallen into their hands.
rows.notes: Belief about capture, not certain assertion.

rows.en: ...Did anyone escape?
We still don't know the details, but I suspect the Martian Successors captured them...
rows.notes: People escaping are Little Baam occupants; likely capture, details remain unknown.

rows.en: I see...
Now we know what the enemy is after.
Yes. They want control over instantaneous transportation technology.
rows.notes: Enemy goal from985 restored with explicit they want predicate; no fit compression.

rows.en: ...Little Baam was equipped with a warp navigation device.
rows.notes: Warp navigation device separate from Boson Jump calculation unit.

rows.en: Though it was badly damaged just before the Baam War ended, and it still hasn't been restored to working order.
rows.notes: Baam War timing retained; no assumption device ever repaired.

rows.en: Perhaps it's fortunate Erika left it that way for fear of it being misused...
rows.notes: Misumaru tentatively sees benefit in Erika leaving damage unrepaired to avoid misuse; final perhaps preserves reflective source question tone.

rows.en: Then those A-Class Jumpers were disappearing one after another because...?
rows.notes: Question trails at because; disappearance predicate restored.

rows.en: Of course, they were probably trying to monopolize Boson Jump technology.
rows.notes: Self-review/root-approved meaning correction: restored enemy subject/action plus source inference likelihood.

rows.en: Th-then it wasn't just those two... Inez too...!?
rows.notes: Interrupted inference retains Inez plus the unnamed pair (Akito/Yurika, settled by original1068/1115-1119/1564) without adding names or fate certainty.

rows.en: Well, I suspect they were also behind the accident involving the plane she was on.
rows.notes: Suspected sabotage presented as suspicion, not confirmed fact.

rows.en: In other words, we no longer have a single A-Class Jumper on our side.
And they have the calculation unit as well...
So they've shut down our ability to perform Boson Jumps.

rows.notes: Silence retained at both uses.

rows.en: Kusakabe always stressed the dangers and importance of Boson Jump.
He may think it's justice, but it's a nightmare for the people he rules over!
rows.notes: Jun condemns the effect on people subjected to Kusakabe's rule.

rows.en: That's true...
Akiyama...
Yes?
What sort of man is Kusakabe? How did he seem to you, as his direct subordinate?
He loves justice with a burning passion... He'd die for his ideals...
rows.notes: Kusakabe's passion and willingness to die restored with English subject/verbs.

rows.en: The problem is, he firmly believes that what he considers ideal must be ideal for everyone else too.
rows.notes: Kusakabe thinks his own ideals are ideal for others; not a claim they already share them.

rows.en: What might he do next?
He'll use Boson Jump to seize the Earth Federation's key facilities all at once.
rows.notes: Akiyama predicts coordinated seizure of key facilities using Boson Jump.

rows.en: Then we must put all those key facilities under heavy guard immediately!
Now, now. There's no need to be so hasty.
The Martian Successors don't have complete control over Boson Jump either, you see.
What guarantee do we have of that!?
If they had complete control, this place would already be a sea of flames.
rows.notes: Misumaru infers lack of complete control from headquarters not already burning.

rows.en: R-right...! Of course...
But it's only a matter of time.
Indeed.
They probably allied with the Giganos Empire to buy time to research Boson Jump technology, but...
rows.notes: Probable alliance rationale remains probable and trails before1018.

rows.en: Once their research is complete, or Little Baam's warp device is repaired, they'll act at once.
...Akiyama, how likely are they to use Little Baam for military purposes?
Well, I doubt it. Little Baam was completely disarmed after the Baam War ended...
rows.notes: Disarmed Little Baam makes military use unlikely, not impossible.

rows.en: Many of the Jovians were deeply moved by the way Admiral Richter died.
rows.notes: Source respects Richter's final moments; no added details of death. Self-review/root-approved meaning correction: made source death explicit without adding circumstances.

rows.en: So I doubt they'll do anything like purge the Baam people.
However, to make the Baam people repair Little Baam's warp device...
rows.notes: Purpose clause deliberately incomplete, continued by hostage possibility1024.

rows.en: there's a strong chance they'll use Erika as a hostage.
rows.notes: Strong likelihood of Erika being used as hostage to force repairs, not a certainty.

rows.en: Then how should we respond...?
For now, we wait and see.
rows.notes: Observe for now, not passive surrender.

rows.en: What!?
As I said earlier, they'll need time to accomplish their goal.
Besides, they have to deal with Gulfer and the Vegan Empire too.
B-but even so...!
Well, don't worry. We don't intend to sit back and watch either.
rows.notes: Akiyama clarifies wait-and-see does not mean merely watching.

rows.en: Besides, with enemies and allies so thoroughly mixed together, the effective approach would be...
rows.notes: Incomplete tactical lead-in is answered by1034.

rows.en: W-what is it?
Guerrilla tactics.
rows.notes: Source answer nominal phrase retained as direct answer to1033.

rows.en: N-no! Now's when we should bring the full might of the Federation forces together...!
rows.notes: Jun proposes assembling full Federation military power; deliberate unfinished protest retained.

rows.en: I understand how you feel, but we have plenty to deal with ourselves. All sorts of things.
Giganos, Gulfer, MU... The Hyakki Empire and Tekkoryu (Iron Dragon)... Then the Vegan Empire, and on top of that, the Angels.
rows.notes: Enemy list remains a nominal list; every listed faction and Angels retained.

rows.en: Yes, the Federation forces certainly have their work cut out for them.
Even so, resorting to guerrilla tactics...
rows.notes: Incomplete objection to guerrilla tactics, answered in original1204-1205.

rows.en: Hey, hey. A former Nadesico A crew member shouldn't be saying that.
rows.notes: Akiyama rebukes Jun for criticizing guerrilla tactics used by the former Nadesico crew.

rows.en: You brought the Lizard War to an end using those very methods, didn't you?
rows.notes: Those methods refer to Jun's guerrilla-tactics objection in the original neighbor.

rows.en: Anyway, I've already taken steps.
Of course, I'll need the Nadesico B and Nahel Argama to buy us time until we can put them into action.
rows.notes: Akiyama asks the two allied ships to buy time for his steps to be implemented.

rows.en: Captain, we have new information on the Nadesico B.
...So they're heading to Earth.
Yes. We believe they probably intend to join up with the Nahel Argama force.
The Nahel Argama force... I hear Kaine Wakaba and the others have acquired new Dragonars...
rows.notes: New Dragonars refers to Kaine's group after their upgrades.

rows.en: Yes. It also seems full-scale production of the mass-produced Dragonar... the Dragoon, has begun.
Hmph. It seems even the Gon Jem Squad, known as Giganos's Filth, couldn't defeat them.
rows.notes: Giganos's Filth is the fixed derogatory squad nickname; no softened equivalent.

rows.en: We must finish them off with our own hands after all...!
Captain, give us the order to sortie. Let's strike the Nadesico B now and reduce their fighting strength.
Hmm...
Sorry, but let us take care of that job.
rows.notes: Albero asks Meio to let his force handle interception.

rows.en: ! You are...!?
Albero Esto... The pilot of the Medius Locus who took part in the battle in Kyoto?
rows.notes: Full Albero Esto and Medius Locus are preserved.

rows.en: ...That's right.
So he went up into space after that, just as we did...
rows.notes: Thought; Meio infers Albero came to space just as Meio's group did.

rows.en: Albero...? I've heard that name somewhere before...
Do you know him?
...I remember now. If I'm not mistaken, he commanded the Federation's special operations unit, the Cry Wolves.
rows.notes: Dan recalls Albero's former command, rather than assuming he is still commander.

rows.en: The Cry Wolves?
Yes. They were one of the Federation military's best units, but they were reportedly wiped out on a mission...

rows.notes: Malformed closing wrapper ignored; silence preserved.

rows.en: Why would a man like that be in our Giganos army?
rows.notes: Karl asks why the former Federation commander is with Giganos.

rows.en: To obtain combat data for the Medius Locus. I have no other purpose.
rows.notes: Combat data is being gathered for Medius Locus.

rows.en: So that's why you want to sortie in our place?
That's right. After this, I'll descend to Earth and join up with the Gon Jem Squad...
I'd like a little gift to bring them before that.
rows.notes: Gift is figurative enemy defeat as a token for Gon Jem Squad, not an item added to the script.

rows.en: That's your own business. It has nothing to do with us.
...Very well.
! Captain...
I'll entrust him with pursuing the Nadesico B.
rows.notes: Meio gives Albero the pursuit assignment.

rows.en: Heh... Leave the external enemies to us. I'm counting on you to deal with the enemy within, Captain.
rows.notes: Albero takes external enemies and asks Meio to handle the internal enemy; request direction preserved.

rows.en: The enemy within...?
Could he mean that man... Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov?
rows.notes: The suspected internal enemy is Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov.

rows.en: ...If even an outsider can see through us, it's only a matter of time before Giganos's foundations are badly shaken...
rows.notes: Thought; outsider insight exposes Giganos's unstable internal foundations.

rows.en: Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov... I really can't leave that man unchecked.
rows.notes: Thought; Meio resolves not to leave Dorchenov unchecked.

rows.en: Thirty minutes until atmospheric entry. Everyone, please perform your final checks.
rows.notes: Ruri asks all crew to perform final checks before atmospheric entry.

rows.en: Roger!
Combat confirmed in the space behind us! We've identified one side as Giganos forces, but the other side...
rows.notes: Hari distinguishes identified Giganos from an unidentified second force; source trailing clause retained.

rows.en: The other side is unidentified, correct?
rows.notes: Ruri confirms Hari's unfinished report; the settled other force is restored as the explicit subject.

rows.en: Yes. They aren't transmitting an identification signal.
Does that mean they aren't our allies...?
Could it be Gulfer?
If so, we'd have received a report from GEAR HQ too.
Then perhaps it's the Vegan Empire...
rows.notes: Vegan Empire follows protected term for the original alliance-force label.

rows.en: Whatever they are, at that distance, they won't be bothering us.
That's right. The Nadesico will continue its descent to Earth.
Wait, Captain. I'd like to check the footage, just to be safe.
Understood. Harry?
rows.notes: Body nickname Harry kept; prefilled speaker Hari unchanged.

rows.en: Yes. I've just captured the footage. I'll transfer it to the main screen.

rows.notes: Punctuation-only shock retained at BOTH s0270:308 and s0270:337.

rows.en: W-what is that!?
1. Gulver FXII reaches its destination
rows.notes: Plain objective label. Protected unit spelling Gulver FXII preserved.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: Ghh... We're surrounded...!
What do we do, Kazuya!? A-at this rate...!!
rows.notes: Nana addresses Kazuya using an affectionate brother-like honorific; personal name used without inventing biological kinship.

rows.en: Stop whining, Nana. We're just one step away from Earth.
B-but our spaceship was destroyed too! We can't go any further...!
rows.notes: Spaceship already destroyed; Nana's following despair deliberately trails off.

rows.en: Does that mean we should give up? Why do you think we've come all this way without transmitting identification signals...!?
rows.notes: Kyoshiro asks why they avoided identification signals; refusal to give up preserved.

rows.en: Th-that's...!
It was all to keep them from noticing us.
rows.notes: Them remains unspecified here; not replaced with a guessed faction.

rows.en: We have to get back to Earth alive, no matter what, and report the truth.
That's right...! I can't die before I meet Captain Bright of the Nahel Argama!
rows.notes: Kazuya must survive until meeting Captain Bright.

rows.en: ...We should be pursuing the Nadesico, but...
rows.notes: Original trailing transition to Eldy's diversion request retained.

rows.en: Are you saying we have to abandon that mission just to intercept that super robot?
rows.notes: Albero questions departing from their pursuit mission to intercept Daimos.

rows.en: Yes. Daimos's power source is a valuable sample for AI1. I'd like to obtain it if possible.
If the records I saw are correct...
In the final battle with Baam, Daimos released all its Daimolite energy... and turned the machine itself into energy.
rows.notes: Thought; all Daimolite energy was released and the machine itself converted to energy.

rows.en: If I can acquire that function, my AI1 will grow even further...
...Obtaining Daimos's power source is an order from Dr. Mitar Zapat.
What...?
rows.notes: Two original uses, including reaction to Kyoshiro before his Napoleon quote; generic surprise works for both.

rows.en: And it's also one way to surpass that devil.
...Hmph, very well. Gewai squad, attack Daimos. Then the Dein squad will capture it.
rows.notes: Gewai squad attacks first; Dein squad must then capture Daimos, not destroy it.

rows.en: Yes, sir!
Are they coming to finish us off...!?
...Kyoshiro, Nana. You two must escape.
What!?
W-what do you mean!?
I'll draw them away! You two descend to Earth while you have the chance!
rows.notes: Kazuya draws enemies away so Kyoshiro and Nana can descend; actor and order direction preserved.

rows.en: Kazuya, you...!
rows.notes: Kyoshiro answers Kazuya volunteering to hold off enemies.

rows.en: N-no! I won't leave my brother behind!
rows.notes: Nana refuses to abandon her brother Kazuya; sibling relation preserved.

rows.en: Just go! Don't forget our real objective!
No! Absolutely not! Kazuya, are you planning to die!?
...Don't be stupid. I've survived everything up to now, haven't I?
rows.notes: Kazuya reassures Nana after source silence1001, without claiming invulnerability.

rows.en: So I'll return, I promise. With you all...
rows.notes: Return with Nana and Kyoshiro to Erika; sentence continues in1126. Grammatical coordination call reviewed against escape-for-help context.
uncertain: With you all rather than to you all resolves the cross-row coordination as jointly returning to Erika; source syntax admits a coordination ambiguity.

rows.en: To Erika.
rows.notes: Continues previous promise; add no extra reunion action.

rows.en: K-Kazuya...!
As the saying goes, "Act with resolve, and even gods and demons will give way"... Kazuya, I put my trust in you.
rows.notes: Kyoshiro quotes a resolve proverb and entrusts Kazuya; no historical source asserted.
uncertain: Quoted saying translated literally from game source; independently licensed English wording and historical attribution are unverified.

rows.en: Of course, Kyoshiro.
Y-you're saying we should run away!? Kyoshiro!!
Think about how Kazuya feels, Nana. Why did he leave the Mars sphere with his heart torn in two, and come all this way...?
rows.notes: Kazuya left Erika on Mars to bring help; describe painful choice, no invented injury.

rows.en: It was all to save Erika... no, the Earth sphere from them. Just as he did in the Baam War.
rows.notes: Self-correction Erika to Earth sphere kept, linking earlier Baam War.

rows.en: I-I...! I know that too!
Then we're going to survive too. We'll stay alive and carry out our mission.
K-Kyoshiro...!
...Our escape point from this sector is over there.
We're going to reach that point, whatever it takes. Understood?
...A-all right...! But, but...!
rows.notes: Retain repeated but and unfinished objection.

rows.en: Kazuya, don't you dare die!
Yeah... I'll see you again later!
All right, begin the attack!
Come on, then!
I, Kazuya Ryuzaki, will never yield to the likes of you!!
Damn! Even if you do this, your son will...
rows.notes: Protagonist appeals to Albero regarding his son, with unfinished ending.

rows.en: Just what I'd expect from Kazuya Ryuzaki. I'll use your strength and the data on Daimolite to nourish the Medius!
rows.notes: Albero intends to feed Medius battle data plus Daimolite data; metaphor preserved.

rows.en: Nourish it...? You don't seem to be a member of Giganos!
Answer me! Why did you pick a fight with me!?
rows.notes: Kazuya demands reason for attack, not a request to fight.

rows.en: Amuro Ray! Fighting you will give the Medius invaluable experience!
This man... He's strong...! Is it his machine's power... no, is it the strength of his unshakable will!?
rows.notes: Amuro corrects machine power to Albero's resolve.

rows.en: I don't get what you're on about, but you targeting us is a real pain!
True, I bear you no grudge or hatred...
But I swore I'd complete the Medius, so I'd never have to relive the regret of that day!
rows.notes: Regret of that day is not explicitly recast as killing son; hidden exposition stays hidden.

rows.en: I've heard your reasons! But let me tell you this... Revenge can never create a future!
Shut up! What could you possibly understand about me!?
I don't understand how you feel!
What!?
But I do know that what you're doing is meaningless!
Before your thirst for revenge destroys you, I... #男愛称 will stop you!!
rows.notes: Domon starts with I then transfers agency to male protagonist placeholder; preserve this self-correction.

rows.en: You know #男愛称, don't you!?
I don't know what happened in the past, but please stop fighting #男愛称!
rows.notes: Hokuto asks Albero to stop fighting protagonist, correct request direction.

rows.en: Don't you dare lecture me, child! Whatever happens, I'll complete the Medius and bury that devil!
rows.notes: Devil remains unidentified in this dialogue.

rows.en: But!!
Forget it, Hokuto! There's only one way to get through to a stubborn old man like this: give him a good hard smack!
rows.notes: Ginga advocates hitting the stubborn opponent once; full force retained.

rows.en: I don't know the whole story, but if you come at us, I'll take you on!
Chibodee Crocket of the Shuffle Alliance...
Very well! My revenge has something to do with you too!
rows.notes: Albero suggests Chibodee is connected to revenge, not that Chibodee himself is target.

rows.en: What!? What the hell do you mean!?
Enough talk!!
Cry Wolves... I've heard that name before...
And the devil you speak of is...
rows.notes: George's identification trails off; do not name revenge target.

rows.en: If you know that much, there's no need for talk, George DeSand!
rows.notes: Full George DeSand fixed spelling preserved.

rows.en: To defeat that thing, I need data on you and the rest of the Shuffle Alliance too!
rows.notes: Devil referent rendered that thing without added name.

rows.en: The pilot of this Gundam... You... You're Rain Mikamura!
How do you know my name...!?
I hold no grudge against you personally... But I cannot help hating you!!
rows.notes: Personal lack of grudge contrasted with hatred of Rain's connection; source ambiguity retained.

rows.en: D-don't tell me... The target of your revenge is...!
rows.notes: Rain infers target but does not name it.

rows.en: K-Kyoshiro! Taking on that thing in the Gulver is reckless!
rows.notes: Short Gulver retained per current campaign glossary; no added FXII.

rows.en: That girl is right! You should regret your own rash actions!
Heh... There's something I just have to say to you...
As the saying goes, "A living soldier is worth far more than a dead emperor"! Those are Napoleon's words!
rows.notes: Kyoshiro attributes quote to Napoleon in-game; independently established verbatim English wording/authentic attribution not verified.
uncertain: Quoted saying translated literally from game source; independently licensed English wording and historical attribution are unverified.

rows.en: You bastard! Are you trying to make a mockery of my revenge!?
Is that all you've got!? Don't hold back!!
...His ability is just as the data indicated.
rows.notes: Eldy evaluates Kazuya's endurance/ability against data.

rows.en: He's the man who brought the Baam War to an end... Of course it is.
Kazuya, you have to survive, whatever it takes...!
rows.notes: Thought Kyoshiro wishes Kazuya survival, not spoken instruction.

rows.en: Come on! Keep coming at me!
He looks like he can hold out a while longer.
rows.notes: Kazuya is the one who can hold out longer.

rows.en: Yes.
Kazuya...!!
Nana, concentrate! We can't afford to get shot down either!
Y-yes!!
It's time, Albero.
All right... Capture the Daimos.
rows.notes: Capture alive accords with subsequent1199, not destroy.

rows.en: I can't lose...! I have a reason I mustn't lose!
I must say, that's an admirable spirit... Kazuya Ryuzaki.

rows.notes: Punctuation shock works both battle reveal and afterbattle reminder about Ruri's hardship.

rows.en: Don't worry. I have no intention of killing you.
What...!?
Your Daimos... We're interested in its power source.
rows.notes: Eldy identifies Daimos's power source as the target, not Kazuya personally.

rows.en: Daimos's power source...!? What do you mean!?
You don't need to know why. You'll come with us without another word.
rows.notes: Albero coercively orders Kazuya to accompany them; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Like hell I will!
I...! I have to get to Earth, for Erika's sake too!!
rows.notes: Kazuya must reach Earth, including for Erika's sake.

rows.en: ...As expected, it seems you have no intention of obeying willingly.
Then we'll have to use force...!
Wait!!
rows.notes: Hidden source speaker stays ???; identity revealed only in1213.

rows.en: Hm!?
! What's that!?
C-could it be...!?
Hmph. So he was near this sector of space...!
rows.notes: Albero recognizes Domon nearby without naming him yet.

rows.en: It's been a while, Kazuya Ryuzaki!
D-Domon...! Domon Kasshu!
That's right... I've come to help you!
W-why are you here...!?
Heh. Our match back then...
rows.notes: Incomplete reference to unsettled prior match remains unfinished and is specified by1218.

rows.en: Yes, we still haven't settled our match at the Colony Martial Arts Championship.
rows.notes: Source Championship title is sourced campaign term, not the Gundam Fight tournament.
uncertain: Colony Martial Arts Championship is source-literal project wording; independently canonical English label unestablished.

rows.en: You...!
rows.notes: Source emotional name/pronoun-only fragment retained.

rows.en: Remember that fight...! The way our fists clashed!!
rows.notes: Domon recalls fists exchanging blows; no outcome invented.

rows.en: So we can settle who's stronger, you're going to survive this, Kazuya Ryuzaki!
rows.notes: Domon insists Kazuya survive so they can settle their rivalry.

rows.en: Fine! That's just what I want!!
The Daimolite energy response...! What on earth is this?
rows.notes: Source notes changed Daimolite energy response but does not explicitly state rising/falling.

rows.en: Heh. Isn't it because of his fighting spirit?
That can't happen. God Gundam has an emotional energy system, so I could understand it there, but...
rows.notes: Approved source-short emotional energy system; conversion not added.
uncertain: Emotional energy system is source-short rendering from longer glossary form; independently canonical English short label unverified.

rows.en: But his Daimos also unites man and machine. It's entirely possible.
rows.notes: Albero argues human-machine unity makes emotional response possible.

rows.en: It's absurd for a machine to react to human emotions without a system to mediate them.
rows.notes: Eldy objects to emotional response absent a mediating system, not to all emotion generally.

rows.en: Such unpredictable factors ought to be eliminated from weapons...
rows.notes: Source trailing elimination principle retained.

rows.en: That devil was vanquished because that hadn't been done.
rows.notes: That devil is Devil Gundam; source short epithet remains short. That hadn't been done refers to eliminating human/emotional uncertainty.

rows.en: But it came back. Wasn't that also because of human will and emotion?
...A control device to prevent such mistakes... That is AI1.
rows.notes: AI1 is proposed as control device preventing mistakes; name and role retained without expanding acronym or revealing later forms.

rows.en: Hmph. You don't understand the true nature of human will and power.
That's why you removed the DFC system from this Medius, isn't it?
rows.notes: DFC acronym preserved unexpanded; exclusion is physical, following argument over human power.

rows.en: I haven't rejected it entirely. Otherwise, I wouldn't have chosen you to pilot Medius.
rows.notes: Eldy says she has not completely rejected human power, citing her choice of Albero as pilot.

rows.en: Enough. There's no point arguing here.
Now that God Gundam has appeared, #男愛称 will be here eventually too.
rows.notes: Exact runtime #男愛称 retained; God Gundam arrival implies Hugo's group will follow.

rows.en: When that happens, I'll carry out my original mission.
rows.notes: Albero returns to original mission, not an offer from Eldy.

rows.en: ...Understood.
Kyoshiro! Look at that!
Thank goodness. Now we've got a chance.
Domon, we've come to help!!
Why are you all here...!?
Heh! I can't let you hog all the glory, Japanese!
rows.notes: Chibodee addresses Domon with source Japanese nickname; keeps friendly competitive swagger.

rows.en: Kazuya Ryuzaki is no stranger to us, either.
rows.notes: George identifies a connection to Kazuya without inventing a specific history.

rows.en: If anything happened to you two, the martial arts world would get boring.
rows.notes: Two are Domon and Kazuya, martial arts rivals.

rows.en: Besides, you've got devoted fans like Ginga, too.
But did all of us really need to come too...?
And now Nadesico has missed its window for atmospheric entry.
Even Domon thought about what came next and took Fuunsaiki along...
rows.notes: Fuunsaiki retained; no horse gender or added atmospheric mechanics.

rows.en: Hey, you punk! And you call yourself a man!?
rows.notes: Ryoko's masculinity insult and force retained.

rows.en: I-I was thinking about the bigger picture...!
Harry isn't wrong, you know.
rows.notes: Body ハーリー uses sourced Harry; source-prefilled Hari speaker elsewhere stays Hari.

rows.en: R-Ruri!?
But we need the information those people have about the Martian Successors.
rows.notes: Those people are rescued Kazuya/Kyoshiro/Nana with Martian Successors information.

rows.en: Captain...
Besides... I don't want to regret leaving people we could have saved without helping them.
rows.notes: Ruri avoids regret over not helping people they can save; no additional past event named.

rows.en: Ruri... You...
rows.notes: Surprised source fragment retained.

rows.en: Anyway, everyone, please launch.
So you've come, #男愛称.
rows.notes: Exact male nickname placeholder retained.

rows.en: Commander...!
rows.notes: Commander-only source address retained.

rows.en: I know...! Let's go, #女愛称!
rows.notes: Exact female nickname placeholder retained; Hugo replies to original741 Aqua's appeal.

rows.en: Oh, so you're targeting us. But can you bring yourself to turn your blade on me?
rows.notes: Albero taunts his former subordinate about attacking him; us then me distinction retained.

rows.en: But I expect an explanation! Why did you return to the battlefield...? Tell me why!
rows.notes: Hugo demands explanation from Albero, responding to original755/756 exchange; not an offer to explain himself.

rows.en: 1. Allied mothership is shot down.
rows.notes: Player; defeat objective; allied carrier condition. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Are those enemy reinforcements!?
No! That's...!!
rows.notes: Source deliberately cuts off identifying decoys; no new identity added.

rows.en: Did it self-destruct!?
rows.notes: Ple Two asks whether Medius self-destructed based on apparent explosion, not confirmed fact.

rows.en: Th-that was... That explosion...!
rows.notes: Aqua's shocked incomplete recognition preserved; later teacher connection not inserted.

rows.en: What happened to Medius Locus!?
Captain, all enemy signals have disappeared.
Then recover all units while we recalculate the atmospheric entry course. Nadesico will descend to Earth.
rows.notes: Ruri orders recovery while re-entry course is recalculated, then Nadesico descent to Earth.

rows.en: Roger!
rows.notes: Both numeric-use contexts checked: docking acknowledgment and later sortie-order acknowledgment.

rows.en: Then, Ambassador Erika... You refuse our demands?
rows.notes: New after-battle scene on Little Baam; Kusakabe confronts Erika about refusing demands.

rows.en: As I've told you many times, I cannot hand Little Baam's warp device over to you.
rows.notes: Centrally approved Little Baam source-literal name retained.
uncertain: Little Baam is centrally approved source-literal compound; independently licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: Know your place. We've already seized control of Little Baam.
rows.notes: Shinjo intimidates Erika after taking Little Baam; not a friendly request.

rows.en: In other words, the warp device is in our hands.
But that device was damaged during the fighting between Earth and Baam, and it remains that way.
rows.notes: Damage occurred during Earth/Baam fighting, no replacement with an expanded war title.

rows.en: That's why we're demanding that it be repaired.
rows.notes: Shinjo demands restoration, coercing Erika as representative. Passive repair wording avoids implying Erika personally performs technical work; source does not name repair workers.

rows.en: You'll hand over the Baam people's instantaneous transportation technology to us at once.
rows.notes: Shinjo demands Baam technology be handed to them; direction preserved.

rows.en: I refuse.
You intend to use it for your own selfish ends. As Baam's representative, I cannot hand it over.
rows.notes: Erika refuses as Baam representative because they intend selfish misuse.

rows.en: This is not for selfish gain. It is to bring the hammer down on the Earth Federation... In other words, a battle for justice.
rows.notes: Shinjo claims their coercion is justice; assertion is preserved without endorsing it.

rows.en: Whatever your reasons, people who casually take human lives have no justice on their side.
You should free Mars and Little Baam at once and surrender to the Federation military.
As expected of the daughter of the late Grand Marshal Leon... and the sister of Admiral Richter, commander of the attack on Earth.
rows.notes: Erika is Leon's daughter and Richter's sister; both source family relationships and Richter's command retained.

rows.en: Your willingness to disregard even your own life for the justice you believe in... I must say, it is admirable.

rows.notes: Six silence uses retained; no guessed emotional speech added.

rows.en: We call ourselves the "Martian Successors", but we originally made our home on Jupiter.
rows.notes: Martian Successors formerly lived on Jupiter; no Jovian faction expansion added.

rows.en: Naturally, many of us saw or heard how the final battle of the Baam War ended.
...What are you trying to say?
Admiral Richter's heroic end... That was the true image of a warrior and a leader.
rows.notes: Kusakabe glorifies Richter's death, which Erika immediately rejects.

rows.en: Please stop glorifying the death of my brother... Richter.
But if the admiral had not slain Marshal Olban, that war would not have ended.
rows.notes: Explicit source rank uses Marshal Olban per current name decision; no rank added to source-short Olban elsewhere.

rows.en: His spirit, courage and resolve... and his final moments deeply moved us as well.
But Richter took his own life to pass judgment on himself for taking the lives of innocent people on Earth.
rows.notes: Richter killed himself to judge his own killing of innocent Earth people; no softening.

rows.en: We are praising the nobility of that spirit.
Then could you do the same thing Richter did?
rows.notes: Erika asks whether the captors can emulate Richter, not whether Richter could do it.

rows.en: Can you pass judgment on yourselves for the people who have died because of your actions?
rows.notes: Erika asks them to judge themselves for victims of their acts.
Malformed closing wrapper ignored; silence preserved.

rows.en: "Hot blood is not blind faith"... You know those words, don't you?
rows.notes: Exact centralized slogan retained inside quotes; not the Hot Blood command.

rows.en: Of course.
It seems you and we are parallel lines that will never meet.
rows.notes: Parallel-lines metaphor retained.

rows.en: Then let me make this clear. We demand that the Baam people repair Little Baam's warp device.
If this demand is not accepted, we cannot guarantee the safety of the Baam people on Little Baam.
And the same applies to your own safety.
It would certainly be difficult to break your spirit...
rows.notes: Kusakabe accepts that Erika's personal resolve is hard to break.

rows.en: Even if we hold the citizens' lives hostage to force repairs to the device, you might not agree as you are now...
rows.notes: Citizens' lives as leverage may not persuade Erika; deliberate uncertainty retained.

rows.en: But what if we do the reverse? You are the leader whom all the people of Baam believe in.
The new home they finally found after wandering the vast universe... and the one who leads them...
rows.notes: Original nominal sequence about the new homeland and its leader remains an unfinished buildup.

rows.en: The people of Baam would accept any demand to save your life.
rows.notes: The reverse leverage is citizens accepting demands to save Erika.

rows.en: How cowardly...
We are carrying out justice. Those who hinder people walking the righteous path deserve to be eliminated.
rows.notes: Villain claims opponents of his righteous path deserve elimination; no softened verb.

rows.en: That is why we had you taken into custody.
But rest assured. If the citizens accept our demand, we will guarantee your safety.
rows.notes: Safety promise is conditional on citizens complying.

rows.en: She is strong-willed...
rows.notes: Shinjo comments on Erika in third person before asking how she might react.

rows.en: But how would she react if she knew that Kazuya Ryuzaki was in danger?
rows.notes: Kazuya's danger is offered as a new coercion method.

rows.en: ! What has happened to Kazuya...!?
He escaped from Mars with his companions and headed for the Earth region. Of course, we have already sent pursuers.
You intend to capture Kazuya and the others too...!?
rows.notes: They seek to capture Kazuya and his companions too.

rows.en: Yes. We will use anything we can...
Just as we have used Captain Yurika Misumaru.
rows.notes: Yurika Misumaru has already been used as leverage; full name retained. Source 大佐 uses Captain from the sourced Nadesico naval profile, per root decision.

rows.en: ...Very well. Do whatever you please with Kazuya.
rows.notes: Erika allows them to try their plan because she trusts Kazuya, not because she abandons him.

rows.en: So you would abandon him for justice?
No. Kazuya is not someone who would easily yield to you.
And he will keep fighting for justice, even if he is all alone.
His courage and convictions will move many people... and his fists will surely strike down evil.
rows.notes: Kazuya's fists and his influence on others both retained.

rows.en: Very well, Ambassador Erika. The justice you and Kazuya Ryuzaki believe in, and our justice...
rows.notes: Source comparison spans 1326-1327; trailing nominal comparison preserved.

rows.en: History will prove which one is victorious.
...Confine the ambassador. But treat her courteously.
rows.notes: Kusakabe orders detention, with courteous treatment; direction of command preserved.

rows.en: Yes, sir.
Ah, Princess... Thank goodness you're safe...
rows.notes: Princess is Margarete's address for Erika; sourced female royal role.

rows.en: Margarete... You were imprisoned too, weren't you?
Who on earth are those people?
They are an organization calling themselves the Martian Successors.
They intend to take me hostage and demand repairs to Little Baam's warp device.
rows.notes: Erika herself is the intended hostage used to demand warp-device repairs.

rows.en: How vile...!
...Princess... Surely you aren't thinking of doing anything foolish...?
rows.notes: Margarete fears Erika may plan suicide; euphemism retained only here, then made explicit in 1337.

rows.en: I, Margarete, will not permit you to take your own life to relieve the burden on the people.
rows.notes: Self-name emphasis and explicit refusal to allow Erika's suicide retained.

rows.en: Thank you, Margarete... But I have no intention of taking my own life.
rows.notes: Erika explicitly rejects suicide.

rows.en: We can only win by staying alive. Choosing death means admitting defeat and shutting off all hope.
Princess...
And I believe in his words...
rows.notes: His words refers to Kazuya; linked promise follows in 1342.

rows.en: His promise: "I will rescue you"...
rows.notes: Source promise is quoted; it is Kazuya promising to rescue Erika.

rows.en: That's right, Princess! Kazuya and Daimos will surely come to rescue us.
...The war between Baam and Earth was also a succession of hardships like these.
But it was by refusing to yield to them and never abandoning hope that we won back then.
That is why we must not let our hardships break us.
Princess, you have become such a fine person...
How happy your father, Grand Marshal Leon, and your brother Richter would be if they were still alive...
rows.notes: Father Leon and brother Richter are both deceased, explicitly hypothetical living response.

rows.en: Kazuya... I believe in you. I believe you will surely save the people of Baam...
rows.notes: Thought; Erika trusts Kazuya to save Baam's people.

rows.en: And, Brother... I too will protect the people of Baam and their future, which you defended.
rows.notes: Thought addressed to deceased brother Richter; people and future he protected both retained.

rows.en: So, Brother, and Kazuya... Please give me courage...
rows.notes: Thought asks brother and Kazuya for courage; not an offer of courage.

rows.en: Your Excellency Marshal Guiltorre, now is the time to approve an all-out attack with the Mass Driver!
rows.notes: Dorchenov asks Guiltorre to approve a Mass Driver attack.

rows.en: We must strike first, before the Federation military mass-produces and deploys the Dragoons!
Many generals support this operation as well.
This is a swift, bloodless strategy that guarantees victory! It will assure our complete triumph!
rows.notes: Dorchenov claims bloodless guaranteed victory; no extra editorial caveat.

rows.en: As I said before, I will not permit the Mass Driver to be used again.
How can you be so soft!?
To realize your ideals... Giganos's ideals, surely we no longer have time to hesitate over sacrifices!
rows.notes: Dorchenov presses for sacrifices to realize Guiltorre's/Giganos's ideals.

rows.en: The people aren't the only ones who will bleed. That blue Earth will, too...
rows.notes: Personification of Earth bleeding retained alongside human victims.

rows.en: What...?
The Mass Driver destroys nature and pollutes the land...
There is no point if we turn our home planet into a place where no one can live.
rows.notes: Home planet here is Earth; Guiltorre opposes destruction of human habitat.

rows.en: B-but, Your Excellency!
That planet's radiance is separate from the Federation government's corruption... Earth's beauty is a treasure that must never be defiled.
rows.notes: Separate natural Earth radiance from political corruption; preserve treasure metaphor.

rows.en: I have no intention of using the Mass Driver for anything beyond a show of force.
rows.notes: Only show of force allowed, not instrumental actual bombardment.

rows.en: Grrr...! At this rate, Giganos will be at a disadvantage.
rows.notes: Thought Dorchenov fears disadvantage from refusal.

rows.en: I must do something before those Federation bastards bare their fangs at us...!
rows.notes: Thought Dorchenov feels urgency against Federation; literal fangs retained.

rows.en: ...That concludes my account of the Martian Successors' terrorist attack.
Understood.
And what happened to Erika...?
She was captured by an assassination squad that answers directly to their leader, Haruki Kusakabe...
rows.notes: Restore captured subject Erika from1370; full Haruki Kusakabe per source.

rows.en: An assassination squad... The pilots of those mobile weapons that attack as a group?
They're called "Hokushin's Six." Every one of them is highly skilled.
rows.notes: Exact existing Hokushin's Six label retained; no extra personal identity.

rows.en: When I escaped from Mars, they stood in my way, so I couldn't rescue Erika and the others...
rows.notes: Kazuya was prevented from rescuing captives while leaving Mars; no rescue success invented.

rows.en: Kazuya, don't blame yourself. There was no way you could take them on in that situation...
rows.notes: Sister Nana reassures Kazuya, sibling wording natural direct address.

rows.en: So they're in the same boat as us...
rows.notes: Thought Ryoko parallels losses of Erika party and Nadesico crew.

rows.en: Lieutenant Commander Hoshino, I have a request. Please let us join your unit and Captain Bright Noa's.
rows.notes: Request direction Kazuya asks Ruri to let all three join Ruri/Bright forces. Root sourced series-specific rank: Lieutenant Commander Hoshino. Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank 大佐 to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: Is that to rescue Ambassador Erika?
rows.notes: Restore is that in the purpose question from Ruri to Kazuya; no source fragment intended.

rows.en: Yes. And to stop the Martian Successors' plans as well...!
All right. But we'll be going to Mars a little later.
Why!? Their goal is to take control of teleportation technology and use it for terrorism!
If we don't stop them as soon as possible, the Earth sphere will...!
rows.notes: Source threat to Earth sphere trails; do not complete catastrophe.

rows.en: We've got other things we need to do too, you see.
We're going back to Earth first, to build up our forces as well.
We can't afford to take our time like that...!
rows.notes: Restore complete objection about insufficient time rather than dangling noun phrase.

rows.en: Ryuzaki, the situation in the Earth sphere is worse than you think.
rows.notes: Source surname Ryuzaki retained.

rows.en: Gulfer, the Vegan Empire, Giganos, Hau Dragon... And there are plenty of other enemies we have to fight.
It should still be a while before the Martian Successors can make their move.
So I think we should do everything we can before then.
rows.notes: Restore we as those who should prepare before enemy can act.

rows.en: But!
Enough, Kazuya.
Kyoshiro...!
Lieutenant Commander Hoshino and the others are in the same situation.
rows.notes: Root sourced series-specific rank: Lieutenant Commander Hoshino.

rows.en: You know Captain Yurika Misumaru, whom they captured, used to be captain of the Nadesico A, don't you?
rows.notes: Captain Yurika Misumaru and Nadesico A formerly captain both retained. Root sourced series-specific rank: Captain Yurika Misumaru.

rows.en: You're not the only one who's suffering. Don't forget that.
...I'm sorry, Lieutenant Commander. I...
rows.notes: Apology and unfinished I clause retained. Root sourced series-specific rank: Lieutenant Commander.

rows.en: As long as you understand. ...Now then, Harry, we're heading for GEAR headquarters.
rows.notes: Body Harry fixed nickname distinct from prefilled speaker Hari1398; GEAR headquarters descriptive composition.

rows.en: Understood, Captain.
Does he have some other objective besides revenge on the Devil Gundam...?
rows.notes: Thought follows all original interleaved Medius dialogue137-173; he is Albero, no hidden additional objective invented.

rows.en: Ginga, Hokuto! You made it back safely!
Of course we did, Koji. We're not going down that easily!
Hey, Koji, is this Burr-head kid the pilot of that Dendoh?
rows.notes: Burr-head is descriptive teasing nickname for close-cropped/spiky haircut, not a new proper name; source nickname queried with root. Root approved descriptive nickname with source-limited provenance.
uncertain: Descriptive haircut nickname Burr-head; exact independently licensed English wording unestablished.

rows.en: I'm not Burr-head! My name is Ginga Izumo!
rows.notes: Preserve nickname rejection and full Ginga Izumo self-introduction. Root approved descriptive nickname with source-limited provenance.
