uncertain: Descriptive haircut nickname Burr-head; exact independently licensed English wording unestablished.

rows.en: Ahaha, sorry, sorry!
I'm sorry, Ginga. Please forgive her rudeness.
rows.notes: Daisuke asks Ginga to forgive sister Maria's rudeness; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Oh, come on, Brother! You don't have to butt in every time!
rows.notes: Maria directly calls Daisuke Brother, enabling next surprise.

rows.en: B-brother!?
Then she's...?
rows.notes: Infer relationship remains incomplete until Maria self-introduces.

rows.en: That's right... My name is Grace Maria Fleed. I'm Duke Fleed's younger sister.
rows.notes: Full Grace Maria Fleed and Duke Fleed exact fixed names; younger sister explicit.

rows.en: Come to think of it, her eyes do look like Daisuke's.
rows.notes: Her eyes resemblance to Daisuke restored.

rows.en: When Planet Fleed was destroyed, an attendant helped Maria escape. She made it to Earth...
rows.notes: Attendant enables Maria escape; singular source does not infer gender.

rows.en: After that, I lived as an Earthling.
Then, after all sorts of twists and turns, she finally managed to reunite with Daisuke.
rows.notes: Maria reunites with Daisuke; no extra itinerary invented.

rows.en: I've decided to fight the Vegan Empire and Gulfer alongside my brother and the others too.
rows.notes: Organizations Vegan Empire/Gulfer exact glossary.

rows.en: So that's how it is. I'm counting on you to look after Maria too.
rows.notes: Koji asks listeners to look after Maria; not offering listener Koji's help.

rows.en: I'm happy for you, Daisuke. Someone from Planet Fleed survived... and your own sister, at that.
rows.notes: Another Planet Fleed survivor and own sister both retained in congratulation.

rows.en: Thank you, Eris.
Daisuke isn't the only one who's happy, though.
What do you mean, Sayaka?
Why don't you ask your own heart?
rows.notes: Ask your heart is Sayaka's pointed insinuation about Koji affection for Maria.

rows.en: Koji! Forget about Sayaka and introduce me to the others!
Sure! Come on, Maria!
Honestly... You're so nice to Maria...!
rows.notes: Source envy preserved, not an explicit romantic confession.

rows.en: Sayaka seems kind of upset. I wonder why?
You really don't know?
I'm asking because I don't know!
Ginga's pretty dense about that sort of thing...
rows.notes: Thought Hokuto recognizes Ginga's romantic obliviousness.

rows.en: ...Looks like everyone's here, Tetsuya.
rows.notes: Jun here is Jun Hono of Great Mazinger, confirmed in original1611 following scene.

rows.en: Yeah. Are those kids the Dendoh pilots?
Who's that old guy?
rows.notes: Old guy triggers continuing age misunderstanding; same phrase preserved.

rows.en: Old guy...?
G-Ginga! That's rude!
...Old guy...
You can't blame them, Tetsuya. To kids that age, all older men look that way.
rows.notes: Jun explains children perceive all adult men as old.

rows.en: I'm still... in my teens.
rows.notes: Tetsuya is still teen, not in20s; source abrupt pause retained.

rows.en: Huh, seriously!? I-I'm sorry! I...
No, it's fine. ...I know I look a bit like that myself.
rows.notes: Tetsuya acknowledges mature looks, not anger.

rows.en: W-what am I going to do...?
rows.notes: Ginga worries about offending Tetsuya; restore complete anxious question.

rows.en: It's all right. Tetsuya wouldn't get angry or depressed over something like that.
Besides... Believe it or not, he's surprisingly fond of kids.
rows.notes: Jun is Jun Hono here; he is Tetsuya, settled by original1609.

rows.en: Um... You're Jun Hono, the pilot of Venus A, aren't you?
rows.notes: Jun Hono and Venus A sourced; not Jun Aoi.

rows.en: Oh, you know about me?
Yes, I've seen you on the TV news several times. Tetsuya Tsurugi too...
rows.notes: Tetsuya Tsurugi also seen on TV; source trailing object fragment retained.

rows.en: I see. Well then, I'll be counting on you from now on.
rows.notes: Jun asks future cooperation; counting on you preserves request direction.

rows.en: Yes!
It's been a while, big bro Domon!
rows.notes: Informal big bro address to Domon, not an asserted biological relationship.

rows.en: You two look well too, Sai Saici, Argo.
Heh... Yeah, we are.
Chibodee, it looks like you and the others joined up safely with Domon's group too.
Yeah. So now the whole Shuffle Alliance is together for the first time in a while.
By the way, where's Allenby? She was with you too, wasn't she?
rows.notes: Allenby gender from explicit glossary profile, not guessed from name.

rows.en: Huh? Come to think of it, where did she go?
W-what is this...?
rows.notes: Actual thought. Vega is surprised by Nobel Gundam.

rows.en: Vega, there you are. Let me introduce the members who joined us after you all went to space.
I'm Captain Haruka Shitow, seconded from TERRA with RahXephon. I look forward to working with you.
rows.notes: Haruka introduces herself with source Captain rank, TERRA secondment and RahXephon; no offering-count-on-me reversal.

rows.en: ...Yes... I'm Vega, Deputy Commander of GEAR...
rows.notes: GEAR Deputy Commander is Vega's explicit role; identity alias not added.

rows.en: I'm Ayato Kamina, RahXephon's pilot.
...I look forward to working with you...
rows.notes: Distracted cooperation greeting remains hesitant.

rows.en: Um... Is that Gundam really so interesting to you?
Oh... I-I'm sorry. J-just a little.
...I thought you might react that way.
Actually, when we first saw it, we...
rows.notes: Source unfinished first-viewing clause; reaction outcome not completed before Allenby interrupts.

rows.en: Hey, hey! Is my Nobel Gundam really that unusual?
Unusual...? Well, how do I put it... I'd like to try piloting it once, I suppose.
rows.notes: Vega wants to try piloting Nobel Gundam; phrased tentatively as source.

rows.en: She's reacting just like Haruka and Misato did...
rows.notes: Actual thought; she is Vega, compared with Haruka/Misato's earlier reactions.

rows.en: Um, may I ask you something?
What is it?
That Gundam... Does it throw tiaras or anything?
rows.notes: Tiara gag retained without identifying a different series in dialogue.

rows.en: No, but it does use ribbons and a hula hoop...
rows.notes: It is Nobel Gundam using ribbons and hoop, not Allenby herself.

rows.en: Then is there a line about "In the name of the moon" or something...?
rows.notes: Incomplete moon slogan preserved with something, not completed to a punishment catchphrase. Source does not specify a unit/pilot speaker, so impersonal is there a line keeps that ambiguity.
uncertain: Exact English texture of incomplete moon-slogan gag is uncertain; source vagueness preserved and catchphrase not completed.

rows.en: It really is the same reaction...
rows.notes: Actual thought; same-reaction observation restored with subject/copula.

rows.en: Now, now, Vega. Let's leave the teasing there. There are all sorts of reasons, okay?
rows.notes: Misato asks Vega to stop teasing and keeps reasons vague, no voice-cast explanation.

rows.en: Y-yes, you're right.
Anyway, Haruka is actually the same age as us.
rows.notes: Same age claim; stray closing quote/break ignored.

rows.en: So can we set ranks and positions aside?
Of course. Then it's just "Haruka" and "Vega"...
rows.notes: First-name terms Haruka/Vega are mutual, not introduction of new identities.

rows.en: Yes. I look forward to working with you.
rows.notes: Haruka's cooperative greeting preserves mutual relationship, no offer reversal.

rows.en: Still, I was surprised. You guys stayed in the military, Kaine!
Well, things just worked out that way again.
You could have had your pilot registrations canceled in Chongqing, right? What made you want to stay?
Well... A change of heart, I guess...
Personally, I'd have been fine with leaving the military, but Kaine here...
rows.notes: Tapp's unfinished blame of Kaine retained.

rows.en: Shut up! If we quit, the Dragonars won't have any pilots and they'll get dismantled!
Huh? Is that what happened?
Yeah. Once the mass-produced Dragoon is complete, the Dragonars, prototypes for collecting data, are no longer needed.
rows.notes: Purpose was collecting data; completed mass production makes original prototypes unnecessary. Final uses a general completion condition rather than asserting a completed past event.

rows.en: So you guys stayed in the military for the Dragonars, Kaine?
...Yeah, pretty much...
Hmm... You do have a good side after all.
It did mean we ended up fighting those crazy Giganos guys who call themselves the Gon Jem Squad, though.
rows.notes: Sourced Gon Jem Squad name retained; speaker complains about resultant fighting.

rows.en: Quit grumbling. The Dragonars got upgraded too. Things will work themselves out.
Did something about the Dragonars change?
Can't you see it!? Their faces, their proportions... They've changed, haven't they!?
Oh, you're right.
So, this Dragonar Mk-II...
rows.notes: Elle's incorrect Mk-II name is deliberate joke and is corrected in1494.

rows.en: It's not Mk-II! It's Custom! Custom!
D-2's changed even more than D-1. Its turret, its outer armor...
rows.notes: External turret/armor changes explicitly contrasted; trailing list retained.

rows.en: But D-3 looks just like it did before.
rows.notes: Mondo discusses appearance; looks resolves comparison to Light's internal upgrades.

rows.en: Oh, mine gets by on what's inside.
rows.notes: D-3 internal strength contrast preserved.

rows.en: Warrant Officer Newman, sir! Lieutenant Douglas would like to speak to you about unit organization.
rows.notes: Warrant Officer Newman is Light; Sergeant Ben formally reports Lieutenant Douglas request about unit organization.

rows.en: Understood. I'll be right there.
Huh? Why's the Sergeant being so formal with Light?
rows.notes: Roux notices changed rank relationship through Ben's formal speech.

rows.en: And a Warrant Officer...?
rows.notes: Warrant Officer echo fragment retained.

rows.en: ...Kaine and the others got promoted in Chongqing, you see.
Who are you...?
I told you before, didn't I? Rose, who came to Earth with us, and...
rows.notes: Rose plus unfinished and points to Linda's self-introduction in1505; names not merged across rows.

rows.en: I'm Linda Plato. I've joined the Nahel Argama squad from Chongqing Base as an operator.
rows.notes: Linda Plato, Chongqing Base and Nahel Argama squad are sourced full/short forms.

rows.en: Linda... Are you the girl Kaine has a one-sided crush on?
rows.notes: Elle tactlessly asks about Kaine's unrequited crush, not an established mutual romance.

rows.en: Huh?
H-hey! Don't go saying things like that!
Hmm... So Kaine really was saying that when we weren't around, huh?
N-no, I mean... I was hoping that someday she'd feel the same, you know...
rows.notes: Kaine hopes feelings will be mutual in the future; no existing romance asserted.

rows.en: I won't let that happen for as long as I live! So there!
rows.notes: Rose's while I live idiom and childish So there retained.

rows.en: Hey, you don't have any right to do that!
But I thought you and Rose were in a refugee camp or something, Linda...?
After that, we went to Chongqing Base... We were helping my father there.
rows.notes: We is Linda and Rose; my father is Lang Plato.

rows.en: Your father...? Could that be...
rows.notes: Unfinished identity guess retained;1516 answers it.

rows.en: That's right. Dr. Lang Plato, the man who developed the Dragonars.
rows.notes: Source-full Dr. Lang Plato correct; no source-short doctor expansion rule applied.

rows.en: Wasn't that doctor missing?
My father was rescued by Captain Quattro Bajeena and went to Chongqing.
rows.notes: Source-full Captain Quattro Bajeena and rescue/departure sequence retained.

rows.en: This Quattro guy... Was he aboard the old Argama...?
rows.notes: Judau asks whether Quattro served aboard previous Argama; Char identity not inserted before next source reveal.

rows.en: Yes. He's a central figure in the AEUG... And his true identity is Char Aznable, Zeon's Red Comet.
rows.notes: Roux identifies Quattro as Char only because this source explicitly reveals it; do not expose hidden speakers elsewhere.

rows.en: W-what!?
A-are you serious!? The Red Comet's that guy, right... The one who's six times as fast!?
rows.notes: Six-times-as-fast boast intentionally wrong, so Roux can correct it next.

rows.en: Three times. Three. Anyway, you guys didn't know?
rows.notes: Three repeated twice; corrects six from1522.

rows.en: But the captain's Full Armor Hyaku Shiki Kai was gold...
rows.notes: Gold Full Armor Hyaku Shiki Kai explains why Kaine missed the Red Comet connection.

rows.en: Wait a minute... Then could it be that right now...
rows.notes: Intentional incomplete inference, answered by Kaine next.

rows.en: Yeah. That means our unit has both the Federation's and Zeon's top aces together...
rows.notes: Restored current allied unit as containing the Federation and Zeon top aces.

rows.en: It's been a while, Char. Since the Gryps Conflict, hasn't it...
rows.notes: Amuro and Char reunite; last meeting is the Gryps Conflict, without adding a year.

rows.en: Would you laugh at me for still being a pilot...?
rows.notes: Quattro asks if Amuro mocks his remaining a pilot.

rows.en: That goes for both of us, doesn't it?
rows.notes: Amuro points out both are still pilots.

rows.en: Just be honest. The battle with Haman wore you out...
rows.notes: Amuro says the battle with Haman exhausted Char; no added account of battlefield events.

rows.en: So you noticed...
That woman used the Zabi family's name as cover to try to become humanity's guide...
rows.notes: Zabi family name is Haman's political cover; guide humanity is her intended role. Root confirmed the Zabi family spelling from official Gundam English material.

rows.en: Whatever her methods, weren't you sympathetic to her feelings even as you fought her?
rows.notes: Amuro separates Haman's methods from the sentiment he thinks Char shared.

rows.en: ...I won't deny it.
So I figured seeing Neo Zeon defeated left you unsure what to do.
rows.notes: Amuro infers doubt after Neo Zeon's defeat, not an already-decided uprising.

rows.en: Are you saying I intend to rise up in Haman's place?
rows.notes: Char asks if Amuro means replacing Haman; remains a question.

rows.en: Who knows... I don't want to think about that in our current situation.
We crushed Zeon, but Giganos appeared immediately afterward... That's the bigger problem right now.
rows.notes: Source-short Zeon remains distinct from preceding Neo Zeon; current Giganos threat takes priority.

rows.en: Yes. Our era has fallen into a cycle of war.
rows.notes: Cycle-of-war metaphor retained.

rows.en: And to guide people in a better direction, we must break that cycle.
rows.notes: Quattro wants the cycle broken to guide people better.

rows.en: That's why you're still a pilot...
If that's so, I have nothing more to say. I'll be relying on you again, Char.
rows.notes: Amuro asks/reasserts reliance on Char for continued cooperation.

rows.en: I'm counting on you too, Amuro.
rows.notes: Quattro reciprocates by counting on Amuro; explicit subject and request direction restored.
